articleTitle: Research on used car price prediction based on random forest and LightGBM
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In recent years, while the scale of the used car market has been expanding, the price evaluation system of my country's second-hand car market has exposed the problem that it does not meet the market demand. Accurate used car price prediction can help people make correct decisions and avoid the wanton price tag of used cars in the market as much as possible. This paper uses the random forest and LightGBM algorithms to predict the price of used cars and compares and analyzes the prediction results. The experiments found that the relevant evaluation indicators of the random forest and LightGBM models are as follows: MSE is 0.0373 and 0.0385 respectively; MAE is 0.125 and 0.117 respectively; The R square of prediction is 0.936 and 0.933 respectively. Among the two prediction models, the prediction error of the LightGBM model is smaller, and it can be considered to be applied to other fields in future research.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Job Recommendation Algorithm for Intelligent Employment System Using User Profile-Based Filtering
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: With high speed of Internet development, especially in area of college employment system (CES), which are used to searching the Internet for these college graduates to acquire the proper positions of the proper company. Meanwhile, how to find the right candidate from the massive graduate-ability data matrix becomes a hard issue. Traditional campus recruitment includes so many steps which will cost much time and human capital. Thus, our proposed hybrid talent recommendation method can solve this problem by predicting the future proper candidate for the company by comparing the ability data of the present company talent with recent campus graduate who do not have any working experience. Ability similarity and demographic similarity are both considered in our method combined with traditional collaborative filtering making our prediction more precise and suitable for College Employment Systems in real situation.

articleTitle: A Review of the Research Progress of Pruning Robots
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Automation and robotics have been applied in various fields of agriculture and forestry. However, most production operations agriculture and forestry still rely on manual labor, among which pruning is one of the most labor-intensive operations. Therefore, robotic pruning is a potential long-term solution to labor shortages and the associated high costs. Although agricultural and forestry pruning is gradually mechanized, the successful application of pruning robotics still faces many challenges. This paper focuses on the core components and key technologies of pruning robots in agriculture and forestry, including machine vision, manipulators, end-effectors, path planning, and obstacle avoidance. Finally, the challenges and potential opportunities faced by pruning robots in agriculture and forestry are discussed.

articleTitle: Optimization algorithm of gait recognition based on EMG signal
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: At present, exoskeleton robot technology is becoming more and more mature, and its application scenarios have covered many aspects. In the field of exoskeleton robot technology, one of the most important research technologies is gait recognition technology. This article studies the human gait phase recognition algorithm based on sEMG of human lower limbs. After using KNN, improved KNN, SVM and dagsvm algorithms for gait recognition, this paper proposes and uses knn-dagsvm algorithm and improved knn-dagsvm algorithm. Finally, according to the recognition results, it is concluded that the average recognition rate of gait phase recognition obtained by using improved knn-dagsvm fusion algorithm is the highest, which is 95.00%..

articleTitle: State Detection of Electric Energy Metering Device Using Computer Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Itis to explore the detection of the state of electric energy metering device by computer neural network. 15 users as the analysis object, the combination of the artificial intelligence technology and the state detection of electric energy metering device; the neural network in the realization method of state detection of electric energy metering device; secondary processing of the collected data of the measurement automation system; two kinds of state detection technology scheme models of neural network were created. A theoretical analysis for the operation state of the electric energy metering device was performed. Through the real case analysis, the priority of the analysis results is I: user 1 and user 48; priority II: user 26, user 45, user 49, user 44; priority III: user 14, user 15, user 20, user 25, user 28, user 30, user 37; priority IV: user 22, user 34. The comprehensive evaluation of the state detection of the electric energy metering device is completed, which further verifies the feasibility of the implementation of the research results and ensures the safe, accurate, stable, and reliable operation of the electric energy metering device.

articleTitle: Research on Deep Forgery Data Identification and Traceability Technology Based on Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: With the acceleration of the digital transformation of the power system, the electronic data in the power production operation has shown an explosive growth. However, the increasing proliferation of deep forgery technology has brought huge hidden dangers to the electronic data management of power grid enterprises, and it is urgent to build a trusted management system for electronic data. This paper proposes a blockchain-based deep forgery data identification and traceability framework. Firstly, a method of trusted identification of electronic data based on blockchain is proposed, which constructs the unique identification of data and embeds it in the electronic data as a digital watermark. Second, introduce blockchain-based electronic data forensic appraisal technology to conduct authenticity and similarity analysis of electronic data. Finally, a deep forgery data traceability mechanism based on digital identification is designed to realize deep forgery data traceability and dissemination supervision. After comparative analysis, the framework is more secure and efficient in deep forgery data supervision, and can provide key support for building a trusted content system in cyberspace.

articleTitle: Simulation of Industrial Robot and Automatic Production Conveyor Based on RobotStudio
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The main content of this paper is to use Robtostudio Software to realize the simulation of a Pallet Assembly Conveyor. It mainly uses the functions of Smart components in Robotstudio software to create multiple sub-components such as: Attacher, Detacher, Source, Sensor and so on, to realize the movement of conveyor and the robot's Attacher and Detacher. In this paper, three robot systems are created to realize the cyclic tasks of Pallet Assembly Conveyor by creating station logic between robot systems.

articleTitle: Improved Markowitz portfolio investment model based on ARIMA model and BP neural network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: A new attempt to apply the ARIMA model and BP neural network algorithm to the daily price prediction of Bitcoin is shown in the paper, and the prediction results performed well. Compared to the ARIMA model, the BP neural network has stronger short-term predictive power for bitcoin price prediction. Second, we apply a modified Markowitz portfolio investment model to the bitcoin portfolio problem. We model the daily price data of gold and bitcoin for October 2016 and calculate that the local optimal return for October is 0.1418, the local minimum risk is 0.000174, and the local optimal portfolio investment of USD, gold, and bitcoin is [8389.8337,0,2.4691].

articleTitle: Research and design of robot obstacle avoidance strategy based on multi-sensor and fuzzy control
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: With the development of microcontrollers, inertial sensors, communication chips and other devices, the popularity of robots and their applications are gradually expanding, and the motion or operating environments they face are becoming more and more complex. In this paper, we use multi-sensor technology to collect information about obstacles, then analyze and identify the collected data, and use fuzzy control algorithms to build a multi-sensor information fusion obstacle avoidance method for robots based on the analyzed obstacle information, improve the robot's obstacle avoidance accuracy and optimize the robot's obstacle avoidance route, and realize the robot's autonomous obstacle avoidance function. This method is used to improve the obstacle avoidance accuracy of the robot and optimize the obstacle avoidance route of the robot.

articleTitle: Research on stock forecasting based on random forest
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The stock market is an important part of the financial market and is closely related to the market development and economic dynamics of the whole country. Due to the volatility of the stock market, such as non-linearity and frequent changes, the accurate prediction of the stock market is usually considered as one of the most challenging problems. In this paper, we propose a stock market prediction model based on the Random Forest algorithm, using historical trading data of several stocks and two ETF funds in the SSE A-share as the research object, and combining AI technology, exemplified by machine learning methods, with the financial industry to predict and analyze stock prices through the model of regression prediction, and the results show that the accuracy of stock prediction using Random Forest is desirable and valuable for guiding institutional and individual stock investments.

articleTitle: Analysis of the operating characteristics of the integrated power system under the action of pulse load
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Aiming at the stability problem of integrated power system under the action of pulse load, a stand-alone simulation model of single-shaft gas turbine, twelve-phase rectified synchronous generator and pulsed load is established, the dynamic process of suddenly adding pulse load to generator sets without thinking about energy storage and pulse power conversion device is analyzed in detail, and the main influencing factors of electrical index changes such as transient voltage regulation rate and transient speed regulation rate of generator sets under pulse load are studied. Simulation tests on the operating characteristics of generator sets under continuous pulse load conditions are also carried out. The results show that the dynamic performance of the generator set is closely related to the operating mode of the pulse load, and the parameter changes such as the rising time, peak power, and time interval of continues loading will have different effects on the dynamic performance of the unit during the loading process, which provides a basis for the coordinated optimization control of the gas turbine speed regulation system and the twelve-phase rectifier synchronous generator excitation system in the next step.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Cloud Computing and Big Data Technology in Intelligent Desktop Virtualization System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: By analyzing the design requirements of a secure desktop virtualization information system, this paper proposes the security virtualization technology of “whitelist” security mechanism, the virtualization layer security technology of optimized design, and the virtual machine security technology of resource and network layer isolation. On this basis, this paper constructs the overall architecture of the secure desktop virtualization information system. This paper studies the desktop virtualization technology research based on VMware using VMware server virtualization solution to transform and upgrade the traditional intelligent desktop virtualization system, improve server resource utilization rate, and reduce operation and maintenance costs.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Methods for Objective Detection
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Object detection is one of the most fundamental computer vision tasks that needs further research. With the rapid evolution of the Deep Neural Networks(DNN) model, Object detection has become a heated discussion among people and thus becoming the research hotspot. However, the research on object detection has made significant progress, with few reviews on this task. As a result, the goal of our work is to provide a comprehensive overview of recent achievements. This paper introduces many aspects of objection detection: benchmarks, metrics, recent research, and neural network models with the help of the research contributions in this field. We also focus on new technologies, so we mainly write two relatively new neural network models called Graph Convolutional Networks(GCN) and Graph Attention Networks(GAT). We finish the survey by listing some long-standing challenges for follow-up research and identifying intriguing future research directions.

articleTitle: An image steganography method based on texture perception
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Existing image steganography technology can resist image attacks, however, the quality of generated encoded image is poor and the low-frequency region can be perceived. To improve the quality of the encoded image, an image steganography method based on texture analysis is proposed. In this method, the gray-level co-occurrence matrix is used to extract the texture information of the cover image, the information is embedded in the complex position of the image, in and the network structure of the StegaStamp encoder is improved, small convolution layers are added in the down-sampling process to expand the receptive field, and channel attention is used to assign different weights to feature channels to enhance the influence of important features of images. The experimental results show that the proposed method can effectively improve the PSNR and SSIM values of coded image, and the quality is improved without degrading the robustness and embedding capacity.

articleTitle: Secure Sharding Scheme of Blockchain Based on Reputation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Nowadays, the implemetation scheme of blockchain system generally has the defect of insufficient saclability, which can not meet the needs of large-scale applications, and imped its development. Sharding technology is regarded as the most likely solution to the current blockchain bottleneck, it divides the nodes of the blockchain network into each shard, which can maximize the transaction processing capacity of the system. In a sharding scheme, the blockchain is split into several blocks, networks with fewer nodes are created, so the reliability of the nodes in the network becomes critical. In this work, a blockchain sharding scheme based on Verifiable Random Functions(VRF) and node reputation is proposed. The nodes are randomly assigned to each shard by VRF, and the nodes are encouraged to work actively through the reputation score of the in-shard nodes. At the same time, the aggregation of malicious nodes is cotrolled to reduce the probability of fragmentation deterioration and influence of the whole blockchain.

articleTitle: Location, Capacity and Reactive Power Optimization Technology of the Power Distribution Network with Distributed Generation by the Neural Network Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In response to the government's proposal to properly control the development of thermal power, vigorously develop the planning of distributed generation (DG), the State Power Corporation has formulated corresponding policies to promote the development of DG. Based on the neural network algorithm, it proposes the reactive power optimization configuration on the basis of the location and capacity of DG in the power distribution network (PDN) and establishes a mathematical model for this configuration of the PDN with DG. The research results reveal that reactive power optimization by adding DG can effectively reduce the grid loss and the voltage deviation in the grid. Therefore, social and environmental benefits are achieved by improving the power supply quality of the PDN, reducing network losses, and increasing economic benefits.

Author Keywords: location and capacity of power distribution network

articleTitle: A Study of Brand Power Simulation by Time Series Based on Flink and Kafka Framework
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: To build a strong automotive company, it is essential to monitor and calculate each indicator of a brand of car and the score of brand power in real time. In this paper, firstly, the subjective and objective data of research data (subjective data) and sales data of each car(objective data) brand in each year and month are combined to form multi-source heterogeneous data. And then data pre-processing is performed on the basis of multi-source heterogeneous data, and the pre-processing includes the removal of attribute features without contribution, detection and filling of outliers and missing values, etc. Secondly, Introduces the advantages of the Flink framework and Kafka framework respectively, as well as the process of reading, storing, computing and running processing, using distributed computing processing and streaming data computing processing; finally, based on the framework of Flink+Kafka for the eight subjective and objective combination of indicators for the calculation of car brand power. The method can basically monitor and calculate the brand power of each car brand in real time, and give the score of each index at any time.

articleTitle: Few-shot Medical Image Classification with MAML Based on Dice Loss
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In medical image processing based on deep learning, medical image datasets are usually few-shot and unbalanced between classes. This will cause the model to overfit and be biased towards the class with more samples during training and the accuracy of the class with fewer samples will decrease. As a result, the overall accuracy will also decrease. To address these issues, the model-agnostic meta-learning based on dice loss is proposed. The algorithm avoids the need for a large amount of data to be driven and can quickly adapt to new tasks with only a small amount of labeled data. Meanwhile, the objective function can be optimized autonomously in the direction of a small number of classes during training. Finally, good results are achieved on two few-shot datasets of medical images. Our method can provide a solution to achieve good results with less data cost in medical image processing.

articleTitle: Research on an improved prediction model based on decision tree algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In this research, we collect and complete a data set of freshmen registration, and use the machine learning algorithm of decision tree to predict it. Our goal is to use this algorithm to verify whether the enrollment of freshmen can be predicted. Then we adopt the pruning scheme to optimize the decision tree. One is to prune the number of layers of the tree, and the other is to prune the number of samples on the leaf nodes. Then, we present the confusion matrix and F1 score to assess the impact of machine learning. The exploratory comes about to appear that the pruning scheme has greatly improved our prediction model.

articleTitle: Capacity Optimization of Wind-Storage Combined Power Generation System in Cold Region Based on Gravity Energy Storage
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: How to plan the capacity of wind farm and gravity energy storage reasonably is the premise to ensure the reliability and economy of wind-storage combined power generation system in cold areas. This paper presents a capacity optimization model of grid connected wind-storage combined power generation system with the minimum total cost as the objective function, taking into account both vertical and slope forms of gravity energy storage. Takes the evaluation indexes such as wind-load complementarity, power loss rate and contribution rate of wind-storage combined power generation system as constraints, uses the genetic algorithm with education strategy to solve the problem. Takes a high latitude cold region in China as an example, comparisons the optimization results of different energy storage forms such as gravity energy storage, battery energy storage and compressed air, proves the superiority of gravity energy storage in high latitude cold region from a long-term perspective.

articleTitle: Development status and development trend of smart grid
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In recent years, as the world gradually enters modern industrial society, the use of electric energy has become frequent, making people's daily lives change dramatically, especially the development of the electric power industry, which is inseparable from the support of electric power system. And the traditional power supply network has been unable to meet the power supply needs of industrial society, so the smart grid came into being and became the mainstream power system. This paper introduces the definition and advantages of smart grids over traditional grids, the background and current status of smart grid development in China and the US, the current challenges facing smart grids and the technologies used to address these challenges.

articleTitle: Simulation Analysis of Temperature Field and Stress Field of Piston of High Power Diesel Engine
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The piston geometric network model is established, Hypermesh software is used to simulate the temperature field and stress field of φ150mm high-power diesel engine piston under the set material properties and boundary conditions. The results show that: (1) The maximum temperature of the piston is 666.5K, which is located at the throat of the piston combustion chamber;(2) The simulated distribution cloud of piston gravitational field was obtained, the maximum thermal stress was 215.1MPa, located in the piston valve pit to the top of the piston transition junction position;(3) The cloud diagram of piston mechanical stress distribution under explosion condition was obtained, The maximum mechanical stress is 145MPa, the interface between the top of the piston and the piston pin seat;(4) The mechanical stress distribution cloud diagram of piston under inertial force condition was obtained, the maximum mechanical stress is 9 MPa, located at the top of the piston cavity.

articleTitle: Simulation research on PID control of new trailing arm active suspension based on genetic algorithm optimization
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: A new type of trailing active arm suspension is proposed, which adopts additional power source control and actively adjusts the body height through the motor's output torque to adapt to different road conditions. The purpose is to solve the problem that wheeled robots have poor ability to overcome obstacles and cannot maintain high efficiency on complex roads. At the same time, a PID control strategy optimized by the genetic algorithm is proposed, which is compared with the fuzzy PID algorithm, and the optimization effect is verified by co-simulation research with AMESim and Simulink. Firstly, the main structure and control method of trailing arm suspension is introduced, and the theoretical model is established according to its body height adjustment system. Secondly, the advantages and feasibility of genetic algorithms are analyzed. Finally, the optimization effect curve is obtained through co-simulation. The research results show that the PID control strategy optimized by the genetic algorithm can obviously reduce the fluctuation of the body height adjustment, and the optimization effect is better than that of the fuzzy PID control.

articleTitle: Tunnel Ventilation System Based on Variable Universe Fuzzy PID Control
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In order to further improve the control efficiency of the tunnel ventilation system and reduce the energy consumption and the maintenance of the operating environment, the fuzzy PID control algorithm is used to fuzzify the tunnel ventilation control system, and the control system is redesigned based on the idea of variable universe. The input and output of the system and the scalable factor, the variable universe adaptive fuzzy PID control algorithm is applied to the tunnel ventilation control system. The simulation simulator is designed by oneself, and the fuzzy PID control system is combined with the variable universe scalable factor control system, and the simulation results of the control system are studied in the simulation software. The results show that in the tunnel ventilation control system, compared with the general traditional fuzzy PID control system, the variable universe fuzzy PID control system has better control effect, and its overshoot is smaller and the adjustment time is shorter.

articleTitle: A Water Body Refuse Cleaning Robot Device
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: A robot device is designed to clean the refuse from river bed and lake bottom or floating refuse on water surface at a depth of about 10 meters. Using umbilical cable to provide power to the device, hydraulic channels and compressed gas. Operators can control the device remotely to make the device float. At the same time, the umbilical cord cable can ensure the safety of the device when it is put down and recovered, and can realize the side charging while working, so as to prolong the working cycle.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Pointer Meter Reading Algorithm Based on Attention U2-Net
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: As one of the most common measuring instruments, the pointer-type analog meter is widely used in factories and substations because of its simple structure and high stability. However the mechanical structure makes it almost impossible to provide digital interfaces directly, thus the most common way of getting reading is still recording by individual, but this could cause high labor costs and lack of reliability. To address this issue, we proposed a compact attention based salient object detection model, which combined the U<sup>2</sup>-Net with a spatial attention module to make the model pay more attention to the pointer and scale area. And the model has been trained and tested on the collected pointer meter datasets from a power substations. In addition, the model has been deployed on the AIoT device to achieve a set of high accuracy and robust remote pointer meter reading system. The test on real scenarios proves the accuracy and robustness of our system.

articleTitle: Two-Stage U-Net for Optic Disc/Cup Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Optic disc/cup segmentation is the key step to calculate cup-to-disc ratio automatically which plays a substantial character in the clinical marker investigation of glaucoma early screening and intelligent diagnosis. However, conventional segmentation methods have disadvantages in determining the boundary of optic disc, identifying optic cup and vessel. This investigation proposes a novel two-stage U-Net to segment optic disc/cup gradually. Domain knowledge of fundus image and widely used morphological processing techniques are integrated in input and output block, which enable the model to improve the optic disc/cup's contrast and correct the unbalanced illumination among all images. Besides, he neural network introduced deep supervision block to facilitate the low-level layers to acquire further semantic knowledge. The proposed algorithm attains pixel-wise AUC of 99.70% and 96.83% for optic disc and cup segmentation separately, which achieves the state-of-the-art representation for these two assignments on the Drishti-GS1 dataset.

articleTitle: A reconfigurable rack-scale interconnect architecture based on PCIe fabric
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Today cloud computation center has become an important component of modern information system. How to achieve the cloud computation center resource sharing and improve resource utilization is an important research topic. In order to improve the resource utilization, rack-scale host (also called converged infrastructure system) is usually used by cloud computation center. This paper proposes a reconfigurable interconnect architecture and resource allocate algorithm for the rack-scale host. The architecture includes CPU node, IO node, PCIe switch node and Ethernet switch node. PCIe switch node is used to connect CPU and PCIe device, and Ethernet switch node is used to configure PCIe fabric. The resource allocation algorithm includes the following steps: request for CPU nodes and IO nodes, initialize PCIe devices, establish device configuration space map, discover new devices and allocate device address space, establish device address space map, establish a map of PCIe device interrupt vectors and CPU interrupt vector tables, and at last load device drivers. The interconnect between CPU and PCIe device is transparent to CPU and OS, so all CPU and OS that can connect to the PCIe device are supported.

articleTitle: Research on commodity sales forecasting based on combination model
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In the age of Internet, accurate sales forecasting model is of great significance to help enterprises cope with the changes of market demand and make a reasonable inventory plan. Due to the influence of many non-linear factors, the precision of traditional sales forecasting model is often unsatisfactory. In order to improve the precision of sales forecasting, this paper uses PCA to reduce the dimension of the input LSTM network data features and retain the useful information in the data, taking full advantage of the advantages of XGBoost model and LSTM neural network model, after removing the noise data, the PCA_LSTM-XGBoost combined sales forecasting model is constructed based on the entity historical data, and the comparison experiments with the single model and two typical time series forecasting models are designed and implemented. The experimental results show that under the same experimental conditions of the enterprise, the PCA_LSTM-XGBoost combination prediction model can reduce the MAPE of at least 8% in the commodity sales volume prediction compared with other models, which indicates that it has higher accuracy and better applicability.

articleTitle: Refining method of mocap data based on LSTM
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Due to the existence of noise in motion capture data, traditional denoising methods often need manual procedures and the effect is not satisfactory. In order to solve the problems, a motion capture denoising method based on LSTM neural network was proposed based on deep learning theory to learn the spatio-temporal relationship of marker positions in motion sequence frames, predict noise data and reconstruct motion capture sequence. The simulation results show that the proposed method can automatically remove the noise in mocap data, and the reconstructed motion sequence can restore the actual motion well. Compared with the traditional denoising method PCA, the reconstruction error increases by at least 30% even in the case of 30% large-scale marker loss, which is a feasible motion capture denoising method.

articleTitle: Learner Modeling Framework Based on Learning Analytics
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Learner modeling is essential to adaptive learning, which is the trend of online learning. Learning analytics is an effective way of learner modeling. This paper suggests a learner modeling framework from the perspective of learning analytics, including the logic layer, data layer, analysis layer, and application layer and provides methodological references for the practice of learner modeling. Empirical research is carried out to verify the validity of the learner modeling framework. The forming of a learner model with the proposed framework is introduced in detail. Finally, the article highlights the critical issues of learner modeling and practical applications. Both the educational theory and platform function are the basis of learner modeling. High-quality data guarantees a high-quality learner model. Moreover, the learner features used for learner modeling should be comprehensive, operable, and reusable.

articleTitle: Control System Design for Welding Robot Workstation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: With the rapid development of the intelligent manufacturing industry, welding robot workstations have been widely applied in the prototyping and manufacturing of industrial products. In this study, the control system design was performed for a welding robot workstation. First, the forward kinematics analysis of the positioner in the welding robot workstation was conducted through the kinematic method. Second, the electrical schematic design of this workstation was implemented by selecting electrical components via electrical design software. Finally, the communication between equipment in the workstation was designed. This study provides a certain theoretical reference for the control system design and research of welding robot workstations and it is of practical significance for applying welding robot workstations to curriculum practice teaching in colleges and universities.

articleTitle: Computer-generated Humour Based on GPT-2
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Humour generation has always been a huge challenge in the area of computational humour. In this paper, we explore how to generate jokes based on keywords by fine-tuning GPT-2 pre-training model based on keywords task and comparing them with the LSTM-based encoder-decoder model. We trained the model by the short jokes of Conan O'Brien and the puns dataset of Yang et al. with the help of Pos-Tagger. Then, we evaluate the humour by using human evaluation and the similarity with keywords and jokes by using automatic evaluation. In terms of the final average score, the performance of our model is better than the LSTM-based encoder-decoder model.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Computer Multimedia Technology in Chinese Cloud Classroom Teaching Practice
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The Chinese teaching system is an open system. The function and structure of the Chinese teaching system will directly affect the teaching effect. Only when the teaching structure of the classroom is reasonable, the development direction of the teaching system is correct, and the feedback link of the system is complete, the best results can be achieved. The effect of language teaching. This paper studies a task-based Chinese classroom interactive teaching system based on ZigBee technology. On the basis of formulating the principle of task-based classroom teaching, the system has functions such as user management, file download, and classroom communication. The effect of the system implementation shows that the functional modules of this system have very high reusability, which can not only improve the teaching efficiency and quality, but also meet the diversified needs of Chinese network-assisted teaching to a large extent. It is worth promoting and applying to various disciplines teaching.

articleTitle: RS-Stack: Defense against Stack Buffer Overflow Attack with Random Shadow Stack
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Shadow stack is a method to prevent stack buffer overflow attack. However, in the existing shadow stack solutions, it is often supposed that the shadow stack is safe, but the reality is not always the case. To overcome it, this paper presents a stack buffer overflow attack defense method based on dynamic shadow stack, which is called RS-Stack. The outstanding advantage of RS-Stack is that the shadow stack address is random, and it is difficult for attackers to locate the shadow stack. In order to further improve the security, RS-Stack separates the shadow stack address for protection, which makes it difficult for attackers to destroy the contents of the shadow stack. RS-Stack provides double protection for shadow stack. We have partly implemented RS-Stack, and the experiment shows that the shadow stack address splitting protection introduce heavily performance overhead. In order not to affect the performance too much, the address split protection is optional, and this mechanism is only used in the environment with high security requirements.

articleTitle: Research on the Impact of Geometry on the Absorber Using Finite Difference Time Domain and Simulation Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Absorbers made of traditional materials are mainly aimed at strong absorption. Usually, they have shortcomings such as large structure size, fixed absorption frequency, low absorption rate per unit thickness, and untunable operating frequency. Through artificially engineered microstructures, metamaterials can acquire exotic but very useful dynamic material properties, thereby enhancing the absorption efficiency of absorbers. This paper investigates the effect of material and geometry on the absorption characteristics of the absorber. The overall shape of the absorber is a laminated structure composed of gold as the substrate, silicon dioxide and silicon alternately superimposed, and the upper and lower surfaces of the top silicon are covered with graphene to achieve broadband absorption in the visible light band. Using Finite Difference Time Domain(FDTD) to carry out simulation analysis, the results show that under the same structure, under the dual influence of geometric shape and material properties, adding graphene coating to the square structure can improve the absorption rate of the model, but circular structure is not sensitive to the number of graphene layers, Under the same material, the square structure model has better absorption characteristics than the circular structure model.

articleTitle: Mid-term Forecast of Electricity Consumption of Enterprises Based on Bi-Directional LSTM and Nonpooling CNN
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Mid-term forecast of the electricity consumption of enterprises (MFECE) plays a critical role in enterprises' power planning, economical operation, and energy management. This article proposes a novel hybrid neural network-based forecast scheme to reduce the uncertainty and instability of MFECE. The proposed hybrid neural network consists of the bi-directional long short-term memory (BLSTM) network and the nonpooling convolutional neural network (NPCNN). This model uses electricity load data and external features such as calendar, weather, and holiday information as input. NPCNN is used to extract features from the input data set. Then the extracted features and electricity load data are input into BLSTM for training, and the electric load is predicted. The proposed method is tested on a set of real enterprise load data sets and compared with several classical algorithms on the same data sets. The experimental results have proved its superiority.

articleTitle: Application and development of robot sports news writing by artificial intelligence
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Robot sports news writing has been widely recognized and popularized both at home and abroad, which improves the quality and efficiency of sports news production and frees journalists from routine work. Combining the characteristics and disadvantages of robot sports news writing, this paper puts forward the development direction and countermeasures of robot sports news writing.

articleTitle: MobileNetV2 Accelerator for Power and Speed Balanced Embedded Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: With the development of AI technology, image classification or recognition by Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) can achieve higher accuracy than traditional image processing algorithms, and even exceed human-level classification performance. However, in order to obtain higher model accuracy, larger and deeper network structures need to be introduced, and the computational cost and memory requirements increase with the model size and number of parameters, which make them difficult to deploy in resource-constrained embedded devices. This paper optimizes the lightweight neural network model MobileNetV2, and designs an accelerator inference architecture that is configurable, low-power, and low-resource by combining the idea of software and hardware co-design. The architecture is based on the Zynq-7020 SOC FPGA heterogeneous platform and uses four configurable hardware computing engines for inference. At a frequency of 100 MHz, the processing speed reaches 16 FPS. In addition, it reaches 86.03% verification accuracy rate on the CIFAR-10 dataset. The overall power consumption of the system is 2.741 W, and the logic and algorithm resources occupied are also lower than other MobileNetV2 hardware accelerators. Since the basic structure of MobileNetV2 can also be used to build higher performance networks, the research in this paper is still applicable when higher prediction accuracy is required.

articleTitle: Computer Aided Structure Design of a Negative Pressure Garbage Cleaning Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: At present, all kinds of garbage trucks are filled and must be dumped back to the garbage yard before returning to the origin to clean up the garbage. This process is time-consuming and oil-consuming. Moreover, all kinds of garbage trucks are dumped by lifting the car. Therefore, they can only be left on the ground and processed with other tools. It requires multiple machines to help complete the treatment of garbage. Almost all garbage trucks put the trash into the carriage, dumped it, and placed debris in classification. Without considering the steps of putting garbage from the carriage, waste was set in type, resulting in time-consuming and resource-consuming problems. Given these problems, this paper designs a multi-functional negative pressure garbage cleaning vehicle, which can classify and place garbage, flexibly dump trash into nearby large garbage bins, and adjust the height of garbage dumping. Referring to the principle of negative pressure ventilation, the cleaning range is extensive, the efficiency is high, the adaptability to the environment is flexible, the garbage can be cleaned by classification. The experimental results show that the designed automatic garbage cleaning machine meets users' needs, creates social benefits, and has high promotion value.

articleTitle: An Integrated Approach to Non-Invasive Diagnosis of Dementia Using Natural Language Processing and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Current diagnosis of dementia revolves around the usage of lengthy clinical tests such as brain scans and blood tests that are also often invasive for the elderly populations that cognitive impairment is common to. A rising trend in care for dementia is the usage of qualitative tests like neuropathological and cognitive assessments to serve as preliminary diagnosis, especially since these do not require invasive procedures and instead are accessible to delicate individuals. Machine learning techniques have slowly gained traction within healthcare, especially as algorithms have the unique ability to process a large amount of quantitative and qualitative data to simple and often binary outputs. Machine learning algorithms are thus particularly suited to the task of diagnosis of dementia. This paper aims to provide a qualitative and non-invasive method for diagnosis of dementia in patients and utilizes a combination of machine learning and natural language processing (NLP). All data for testing and training of the model was sourced from the Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System (BRFSS), an annual survey assessment conducted by the CDC. In our proposed model, a conversational chatbot collects data from individuals surrounding multiple qualitative predictors, and these values are then fed into a machine learning algorithm to provide an output for presence of dementia. The strongest performing algorithm was a random forest algorithm, which outperforms the current state-of-the-art, with an AUC-PR score of 0.832 and an MCC score of 0.53. Models like those proposed by our paper have the potential to revolutionize effective care for patients facing dementia, making diagnosis much quicker and easier to access.

articleTitle: The Energy Consumption Value Analysis of Passive Ultra-Low Energy Consumption Residential Buildings
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: According to the characteristics of residential building, we extract the typical model of geometric characteristics, determine the form formation stage and comprehensive stage of variables, external wall/roof/base plate heat transfer coefficient, outside the window heat transfer coefficient and shading coefficient and the parameters of the HVAC system, air tightness and thermal bridge range assignment, then the passive ultra-low energy consumption of residential building energy consumption target model is set up, the simulation of building energy consumption was carried out, and statistical methods were used to analyze the simulation results of energy consumption. The target value of heating demand in the form generation stage was derived. It is of great significance to effectively control energy consumption, improve design efficiency and ensure the realization of the overall goal of passive ultra-low energy consumption in the early stage of building design.

articleTitle: Application Research of Monitoring Abnormal Behavior Analysis and Detection Method Based on GANomaly Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: With the wide application of video surveillance, video surveillance has achieved full coverage of various key places. For video surveillance, the amount of internal information is huge, and the degree of reduction of events is high. Traditionally, a real-time manual inspection can neither meet the full coverage of the time nor achieve the full range of space with low labor cost. The idea of using semi-supervised generative adversarial networks for abnormal behavior detection is proposed to deal with this problem. This paper focuses on this problem, starting from the structure and optimization of the auto-encoder, and studies the basic method of using the encoder for feature extraction. After that, the convolutional generative adversarial network was constructed, and GANomaly was further optimized to detect anomalies by comparing the feature differences between the original image and the abstract image to improve its anti-interference ability. Finally, this paper discusses the reconstruction method of the loss function and defines the loss functions of the adversarial training and discriminative models, respectively. The research in this paper is expected to effectively improve the effect of monitoring abnormal behavior detection and enhance the application value of video surveillance real-time detection.

articleTitle: Analysis. Simulation, and Implementation of Zero Output Impedance for Single-phase Inverter
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: To demonstrate an ideal inverter, zero output impedance for single-phase inverters is proposed based on the state space model. The proposed controller consists of four parallel parts: a reference output voltage compensation part, a direct load current feed-forward compensation part, a capacitor current controller and an output voltage controller. Zero tracking error of the inverter can be achieved by the reference output voltage compensation. Furthermore, zero output impedance can be realized by matching filter parameters to their actual values. Moreover, for linear or nonlinear loads, a fast dynamic response can be achieved using the inner current controller, and a good steady-state performance can be obtained because of the outer voltage controller. Finally, simulation and experimental results show that the proposed control scheme has a fast dynamic response, zero steady-state error and strong robustness.

articleTitle: Personalized Intelligent Recommendation of Cultural Resources Based on User Preference Collaborative Filtering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: With the rapid growth of user information, more and more netizens hope to obtain more comprehensive and effective useful resources through the Internet. However, the traditional information retrieval system can not meet the requirements of its very large amount of data, especially complex and extremely valuable because of the low efficiency of algorithm, low accuracy and limited database resources. Therefore, this paper proposes a collaborative filtering algorithm based on user preference to study the personalized recommendation of ethnic cultural resources. Firstly, this paper introduces the concept, function and characteristics of ethnic cultural resources, and then studies the collaborative filtering algorithm based on users' preferences. On this basis, the personalized recommendation framework of ethnic cultural resources is studied, and the operation performance of this framework is tested. The final test results show that the personalized recommendation method of ethnic cultural resources based on user preference collaborative filtering algorithm is different from other similar applications. Using the same attribute set for the same purpose can obtain more similarity information. Therefore, it can be seen that the personalized recommendation method of ethnic cultural resources based on user preference collaborative filtering algorithm can meet the basic needs.

articleTitle: Research on Optimization of Rural Street Space Based on Space Syntax-Taking the Malan Guan Village in Hebei Province as an Example
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This paper uses space syntax to analyze rural space. This case collects the data of the number and length of rural streets, and then establishes the data into a spatial model. The spatial model was put into Depthmap software for calculation. Then space syntax software is used to analyze the integration, selectivity and comprehensibility of rural street space. Finally, the spatial structure characteristics of Malan Guan village are obtained, and the spatial optimization strategy is proposed.

articleTitle: Study on Durability Computer Evaluation Model of Underwater Pile Foundation of Concrete Bridge
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Concrete structure is a widely used structural form in bridge engineering. Due to the influence of the material itself and the use environment, various diseases are prone to occur, and the durability problem is prominent. Reliable assessment of the durability of existing bridge pile foundations plays an important role in ensuring the long-term performance of bridges. Starting from the current durability of concrete bridge pile foundations, this paper tests the material condition and state parameters of the pile foundation in water, and evaluates the durability of concrete structures to provide a scientific basis for the formulation and implementation of bridge preventive maintenance and repair plans.

articleTitle: Investigation on novel comparator design
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This paper investigates four innovative comparators design and their performance. A Latch-type comparator comprising two cross-coupled inverters is altered for fast operation, with advantages of a high-impedance input, robustness against mismatch, and no static power consumption kept. A splendid technique is a low-power high-precision comparator with an offset scheme implemented on it, achieving a fast and robust offset convergence. The scheme barely introduces delay and mismatch and is designed with minimal extra power consumption and delay. A novel triple-Latch Feedforward (TLFF) fully Dynamic Comparator composed with three stage latches and a feedforward path is proposed to reduce the delay remarkably for large differential input. Another dynamic-bias comparator is designed and compared with prior study, saving the energy consumption considerably with given noise. However, it sacrifices the operation speed due to incomplete discharge. Considerations on the circuit design and performances of the above-mentioned comparators will be discussed in this paper.

articleTitle: Research on Full Chain Construction Intelligent Control System and Return Evaluation Model Mathematical Optimization
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Aiming at various problems existing in construction projects, this paper constructs a whole-chain intelligent control system for construction projects, and studies the optimal path of the intelligent control system return evaluation model. By collecting a large amount of data generated in the construction management process, in order to improve the control efficiency and accuracy, the construction process data is classified and organically linked with the control process, and a data-driven model is constructed. Describe and model the internal structure and construction process of the whole chain of heterogeneous data of the construction project, and generalize the effect of heterogeneous data to each sub-process, design the UML fusion mechanism, and embed the data-driven UML fusion into the control The whole chain intelligent control system of process and construction projects. Finally, the general return evaluation model is optimized and improved, in order to more accurately evaluate the performance of the whole chain construction intelligent control system in terms of control effect and control income.

articleTitle: Adaptive Equalizer for 112 Gb/s DB-PAM4 SerDes
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In order to further improve the signal transmission efficiency, this paper designs a 112Gbps DB-PAM4 adaptive equalizer applied to the backplane channel. Aiming at the problem of complex generation of traditional DB-PAM4 signals and high equalization strength, this article adopts a new generation method of DB-PAM4 based on the backplane channel. Aiming at the problems of complicated adjustment of traditional equalization algorithms and slow tap convergence speed, In this paper, a joint adaptive equalization algorithm is used to adjust the degradation resistance of CTLE and the tap coefficients of FFE and DFE. This algorithm can take advantage of the advantages of different equalizers to make the tap coefficients fast and stable. Finally, the algorithm was verified by behavioral-level simulation in MATLAB. The results show that adaptive equalization of the channel can produce a better duo-binary effect. At a data rate of 112Gbps, the channel attenuation reaches -35dB, and the tap coefficients of FFE and DFE are Stable within 27ns, and the remaining error is less than 0.03V.

articleTitle: Quantitative Evaluation of Vehicle Stability Based on Phase Plane Space
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The analysis of vehicle stability can provide an important theoretical basis for the structural design and stability controller design of the vehicle. The current stability analysis methods lack the quantitative description of vehicle stability, and the evaluation indicators used are few, which makes the evaluation effect is limited when the vehicle is close to the instability boundary. To solve this problem, the vehicle stability is quantitatively described by yaw rate, sideslip angle, front-tire slip angle, and rear-tire slip angle. By constructing stable boundary and critical stable region, and model normalizing, a more consistent and balanced comprehensive evaluation result near the stable boundary is obtained. The validity of the model is verified by testing in a simulation platform.

articleTitle: Full-scene fault research of primary and secondary fusion equipment based on data platform
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: A full-scenario fault analysis method for primary and secondary fusion equipment based on data platform is proposed. The types and methods of low-voltage distribution network fault scenarios are described, and the factors that affect distribution network fault simulation are analyzed. The single-phase grounding fault model of low-voltage distribution network is described, the small resistance grounding system model and the arc suppression coil grounding system model are established, and the influencing factors of the two when simulating faults are analyzed. Based on the data platform, the convolutional neural network fault diagnosis method is proposed, and the process analysis is carried out in combination with the functional characteristics of the primary and secondary equipment fusion device. The simulation analysis verifies the effectiveness of the fault scenario simulation proposed in this paper in terms of data accuracy and training data results.

articleTitle: Structure Design of an Autonomous Separated Modular Snake Robot
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Aiming at the huge demand for robots in the field of exploration and the insufficient survival ability to exist robots, an autonomous separable and reconfigurable modular snake-like robot was developed. According to the physiological structure and movement mechanism of biological snakes, the body structure model of the snake robot is designed. Each module is connected in an orthogonal manner, and the separated modules are separated and reconstructed by the electromagnet. Secondly, the kinematics model of snake-like robot is established, its gait is planned, the motion control function is obtained, the influence of each control parameter is discussed, and the basic conditions of motion are obtained. Finally, the control function is simulated and optimized, and the relationship between motion parameters is analyzed to verify the feasibility of the structure design.

articleTitle: Intelligent Decisionmaking System through LSTM Prediction Model and DQN algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Today's market is trading more frequently, and traditional forecasting models are no longer applicable. Inspired by AlphaGo's game ideas, after consulting the economic and financial research literature related to artificial intelligence at home and abroad, in order to maximize traders' returns, minimize risks, and optimize decisions, this paper proposes an intelligent body decision model based on deep reinforcement learning and applies it to the actual columns of this paper. an LSTM prediction model was established to predict the price of gold and Bitcoin, and it was found that the data fit worked best when the number of iterations was 100. Then, the CPMA model is established to establish a risk assessment mechanism and make preconditions for the decision-making model. Finally, a reinforcement learning model is established based on artificial intelligence, and LSTM is used to extract data features and is combined with DQN algorithm to solve. Based on the CPMA model of problem one, we correlate this improved model with transaction costs. And conduct descriptive statistics on the relationship between yield rate and cost of revenue. It can be seen that the transaction cost adjustment has a large short-term impact on the market, and the long-term impact is relatively small. Therefore, we recommend reducing costs appropriately to improve profitability.

articleTitle: Research on the application of BIM technology in the whole life cycle of assembly building
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In recent years, the development of prefabricated building in China is very rapid, BIM technology platform is the key technology platform to help the industrialization of prefabricated building. Based on the analysis of the restrictive factors of prefabricated building development, this paper analyzes the application of BIM technology in the whole life cycle of prefabricated building, and puts forward measures to promote the deep integration of BIM technology and prefabricated building, which provides reference for the industrialization development of prefabricated building.

Author Keywords: Overall management of the whole process

articleTitle: A mathematical question matching and ranking method based on knowledge graph and semantic similarity
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Nowadays, we are in the era of big data on the Internet, and a huge and scattered number of mathematics questions have been accumulated on the Internet. How to use efficient algorithms to calculate the similarity between maths questions and allow maths questions to be clustered is one of the difficulties in building a maths question recommendation system. As the current mainstream uses manual matching + full text semantic similarity calculation, i.e., it requires a lot of manpower and cannot take into account the image and formula information of certain questions resulting in low accuracy rate. In order to solve the above problems, this paper designs a matching clustering method for similar questions based on the knowledge map of mathematical questions, and then ranks the matched questions by the semantic similarity of the text. The experimental results show that the average accuracy of the BERT-based semantic similarity ranking method is 5.6% higher than that of the baseline method, which can significantly improve the recommendation effect of similar maths questions.

articleTitle: Design and performance study of a BMI-based hand-assisted robot
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Forty-six percent of stroke patients, of whom 80 percent are not treated in a timely manner, have hand paralysis syndrome that lasts a lifetime. The integration and control of external rehabilitation devices based on EEG signal collection is gaining more attention and research, and this type of research has a wide range of directions to improve the quality of life for users. The research aims to study the design and performance of BMI-based hand-assisted robots. Existing robotics and equipment are relatively expensive, and the programmed procedures are not well adapted to different stroke users. Through experimental development and research of innovative BMI brain-computer interface devices, customized programming of experimental protocols, situational awareness of assistive robotics system data processing, brain-computer driven device testing and human-computer interaction methods, and finally after 510 practical tests concluded that patients can get significant rehabilitation process, especially for in the clinical state. The innovative system-on-a-chip research and ergonomic design confirmed that it meets the standards of rehabilitation practice and can significantly improve the patient's cognitive abilities during learning and rehabilitation and more efficiently facilitate the patient's recovery.

articleTitle: A $3\mathrm{D}$ Model of Two-degree-of- freedom and Sliding Mode Triboelectric Nanogenerator Coupled with Power Management Circuit
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The triboelectric nanogenerator (TENG), which is a great potential energy collection technology, can harvest mechanical energy from environment to power microelectronic devices through a power management circuit (PMC). In this study, a <tex>$\mathbf{3D}$</tex> model of sliding-mode TENG (S-TENG) with PMC is established. The <tex>$\mathbf{3D}$</tex> S-TENG model moves with two-degree-of-freedom in the plane, which is different from the conventional motion mode. The finite element method (FEM) is utilized to characterize the distributions of electric intensity, electric potential, and charges on the metal electrodes. Based on the FEM calculation, the effective working area of the S-TENG is determined.and the output characteristics are built. Finally, the energy transfer process including the changes of voltage and current from S-TENG to PMC is revealed, based on the coupling model. This work provides a practical method for analyzing two-degree-of-freedom S-TENG model coupled with PMC, and clarifies its physical mechanism.

articleTitle: Application of Artificial Intelligence Technology in Criminal Risk Intelligent Assessment Model
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This paper summarizes the latest research on criminal risk assessment at home and abroad, and it is a developing trend to use artificial intelligence technology for risk assessment. The method of static + dynamic information collection is adopted for data collection. Establish the data classification model, establish the criminal classification and evaluation model; Data analysis with artificial intelligence technology, instant warning.

articleTitle: Application Research on Intelligent Design System of Indoor Public Space Based on Computer AI Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The data deconstruction ability and visual imaging ability of virtual reality technology in space determine that it has a great development prospect in the field of interior space design. This paper studies the application of virtual reality technology in indoor space performance through the analysis of the application of virtual reality technology in the indoor space of IoT smart home. Based on computer AI technology, this paper proposes a rational design method for small indoor spaces based on 3D vision. First, the small indoor space calibration of 3D vision is carried out, and the corresponding relationship between the imaging plane and the 3D points is obtained, which lays the foundation for the layout planning of the small indoor space. Use the see-through imaging model to achieve 3D visualization of indoor space. Then we use the sparse segmentation method to reconstruct visual features, fuse information, match edge pixels, and combine color features to complete the design of a three-dimensional simulation system for indoor space layout. The simulation results show that the imaging effect and efficiency of the system are better than those of the contrast system, and it has better applicability.

articleTitle: Temperature analysis and modification optimization of gear meshing transmission based on ABAQUS
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: When gears are meshed and driven under heavy load and high-speed working conditions, a lot of heat will be generated due to the friction between teeth. The tooth will produce thermal stress due to uneven friction heat distribution, which will affect the use of the gear. The thermal coupling analysis of an external meshing gear is carried out by ABAQUS finite element software, and the gear is modified at various angles to explore the best modification angle. After analysis, a total of six groups of results were obtained, one group was not modified, and the other five groups were modified at different angles. In the six groups of results, it can be clearly observed that the heat generated by gear meshing is mainly unevenly distributed in the middle of gear teeth along the axial direction, which is an important factor in generating thermal stress. And the heat can be reduced after proper modification of the gear, so as to reduce the temperature difference and reduce the thermal stress.

articleTitle: Sentiment Classification Model of Online Reviews Based on Word Features and Bi-LSTM
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: With the rapid development of e-commerce, many purchase and comment records are produced. Sentiment classification of commodity reviews is of great value for automatically monitoring bad reviews and assisting merchants in analyzing consumer feedback. At present, the Bi-LSTM model is representative of Chinese text sentiment classification, which can understand the semantic information in time sequence. However, due to the lack of processing lexical information, there is a problem that word vectors cannot highlight the information of sentiment words. Therefore, this paper proposes a sentiment classification model of Chinese product reviews based on word features and Bi-LSTM. The new model firstly uses Word2vec's CBOW model to train the word vectors, secondly uses an improved information gain algorithm with the word distribution and sentiment weights to calculate the amount of information, and finally uses the Naive Bayes model to classify the network classification results twice, which solves the problem that the basic Bi-LSTM model lacks understanding of lexical information. The experimental results show that the new model achieves better results relative to the basic Bi-LSTM model and can capture the sentiment information of the comments more accurately. In the test set, the accuracy rate reached 89.03%.

articleTitle: Realization Technology of Texture Feature Extraction Algorithm of Remote Sensing Satellite Image Based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In recent years, the research on remote sensing image information output has developed rapidly, including not only remote sensing technology, image processing, pattern recognition, etc., but also land use, environmental monitoring, disaster forecasting, urban planning and other fields. The purpose of this paper is to study the realization technology of remote sensing satellite image texture feature extraction algorithm based on FPGA. A hardware system implementation scheme based on FPGA is proposed. Firstly, the overall structure of the system is established, and the software and hardware platforms are selected. Then, according to the difficulty of the algorithm, it is proposed to divide the algorithm into two parts, and the system based on hardware logic and based on soft core processor is described in detail. Implementation plan. An object modeling method based on Gabor texture blocks is introduced. This method is applied to the extraction of urban buildings from remote sensing images, and the final building extraction accuracy reaches 91.5%.

articleTitle: Apllication of artificial intelligence algorithm on IPO underpricing rate based on multiple regression analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Based on AI multiple regression analysis, this paper studies the impact of family members' participation in management on IPO underpricing. The IPO underpricing rate of enterprises with family members' participation in management is significantly lower than that of other private enterprises, and the IPO underpricing rate of enterprises with family members as CEO is lower than that of enterprises with non-family members as CEO. This paper first analyzes the data through descriptive statistics and correlation analysis, and then studies its impact on IPO underpricing rate of family-involved enterprises through multiple regression analysis, expanding the previous literature on family-involved enterprises.

articleTitle: Cluster-Then-Label Strategy for Sleep Detection U sing Electroencephalogram (EEG)
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Data deficiency has long been a major obstacle for many areas of machine learning. Manually labeling data could be utterly time-consuming and expensive, especially in medical fields including the sleep research. To address this challenge, we propose a cluster-then-label strategy, which inserts clustering algorithms into traditional supervised learning pipelines. In this paper, we demonstrate the cluster-then-label strategy for sleep detection using electroencephalogram (EEG) data and show that our proposed strategy can boost the classifier's performance on previously unseen subjects. We also developed a method based on nonlinear transformations that can reshape the feature distributions to resemble normal distributions with which the cluster-then-label algorithm becomes more efficient and robust.

articleTitle: Optimized Control of Steering Mechanism Based on Active Radial Bogie
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This paper introduces three sorts of algorithms to search for an optimal steering angle control of the active radial bogie with the optimized parameters of the PID controller. Thus, a convergence effect with no overshoot, no steady-state error, and high response speed can be achieved. By building a mathematical model of the multi-link mechanism, BLDC drive, and gearbox, the transfer function of the whole drive system can be calculated and applied to the closed-loop control of the system. Finally, a series of simulation experiments show that the genetic algorithmic rule we introduced can be successfully used to the active steering angle control of ARB with high efficiency.

articleTitle: Research on Panoramic Fault Simulation Method of Electric Power Communication Transmission Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: With the rapid development of electric power system, it is urgent to find out an effective and flexible transmission network fault simulation method to improve the fault analysis and handling competence of communication network operation and maintenance personnel. Aiming at the problems of current fault simulation solutions, this paper proposes a new panoramic fault simulation method of electric power communication transmission network. Firstly, the overall process of the method and simulation objects are introduced. Then the details of 4 main steps of the method are explained, such as equipment/cable simulation modeling building, fault simulation model building, simulation transmission network generation, fault loading the triggering. Finally, the application results of the method are briefly introduced. The method provides a new solution to panoramically recurrence of various types of electric power communication transmission faults, and supports the communication professionals to analyze the faults and improves their fault handling competence.

articleTitle: Machine vision-based information collection system for collector coin grading boxes
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: With the goal of automating the information system acquisition of collector coin grading boxes, this paper designs a vision-based grading box target acquisition robot platform.
