For the problem of information extraction of grading box images, a character recognition algorithm based on watershed area segmentation is proposed to improve the recognition accuracy of sticky characters, and an information acquisition robot application software is developed. The experimental and application results show that the image acquisition of the collector coin grading box information acquisition system is clear and the character information recognition rate reaches 1000%, which realizes the efficient and fully automated information acquisition of the collector coin grading box information acquisition system.

articleTitle: Application of Virtual Reality in Different Fields
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: VR, also known as Virtual Reality technology, is a new hot technology, its research content is suitable for different fields in the construction of application, so it has a good prospect for development. VR is facilitating human life, and some industries including education, games, health care etc. This paper combining with some examples, combs VR's development history and summarizes the application of VR in games, education and health care. Specific, this paper analyzes the development status of VR and summarizes the impact of VR on these fields. Compare the differences between traditional games and VR games. In particular, we also focus on the advantages and disadvantages of VR in these three fields. These contents are of great significance for analyzing and discussing the development prospects of VR in these fields. At the end of all, this paper give summary and forecast the prospect of VR technology.

articleTitle: Research on Component Incremental Integration Testing Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The research on component incremental integration testing technology, firstly, the component incremental integration testing design is carried out, and the component incremental integration process is described; then, according to the integration testing design, a simulation test is proposed for each component integration test in the integration testing process. Combined with physical testing, the integration testing method analyzes the interaction between the components under test and the unintegrated components in the system, and establishes the component integration interaction model; then according to the component integration interaction model, the test cases are described by XML; finally, the C++ based on the XSLT style sheet is used. The script framework converts test cases into test scripts, designs a component integration test framework, drives binary integration test script programs in this framework, and tests the components under test.

articleTitle: Application of passive capacitive DC blocking device in the treatment of DC bias in State Grid Jiangxi Electric power Co
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: With the construction of UHV DC power transmission, the main transformers of surrounding substations have a serious impact on DC bias, which threatens the safety of the main transformers. This paper analyzes and selects the DC blocking device from the aspects of equipment selection, overvoltage and insulation coordination, operation and maintenance, etc., through the analysis of the influence principle of DC bias and applies it to the actual project. Certain reference value.

articleTitle: Research on control strategy of storage and DC hybrid energy storage based on new energy microgrid
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: DC microgrid will not only cause large-scale fluctuations, but also lead to power imbalance, which makes the system unreliable. It will not only cause system instability, but also lead the whole system into a chaotic operating state. In this regard, this paper proposes an energy management optimization method for DC microgrids including photovoltaics and hybrid energy storage, which can quickly stabilize the bus voltage fluctuations caused by the imbalance of system power supply and demand. In the grid-connected state, the DC microgrid exchanges energy with the large grid through the grid-connected converter; in the off-grid state, the photovoltaic module and the hybrid energy storage module coordinate and cooperate to supply power to the local load, avoiding the small-scale fluctuation of the DC bus voltage. Power electronic devices operate frequently, so that new energy and energy storage give priority to power supply to the load.

articleTitle: Calculation and Analysis of Large Current Switching Test of On-load Tap-changer
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The On-load Tap-changer of the converter transformer operates frequently and the operating condition is bad, which requires extremely high breaking capacity and long-term reliability. Large current switching test is a key test to evaluate the breaking performance of On-load Tap-changer. However, there are few quantitative studies on the changes of electrical parameters and test equivalence during the test. This research is based on the large current switching test of On-load Tap-changer using resonance method. Firstly, the variation law of the electrical quantities in the test system under each action stage of the On-load Tap-changer is calculated by using the equivalent transformation of the electrical topology. Then, the deviation between the current and voltage in the test circuit and the current and voltage of the On-load Tap-changer under actual operation state is calculated, and the test equivalence and influencing factors are analyzed. Finally, the correctness of the calculation and analysis is verified by the actual large current switching test waveform of an On-load Tap-changer, and the suggestions for large current switching test are given.

articleTitle: Design and Application of Intelligent Learning Cloud Platform for Power Simulation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Aiming at the shortcomings of the existing power simulation training platform, this paper proposes a method for building a power simulation smart learning cloud platform based on technologies such as microservices, artificial intelligence, dynamic evaluation, and gamification. The platform effectively solves the “contradictions between work and learning” of power grid operators, and supports learners to use fragmented time to carry out practical skills simulation learning anytime and anywhere. The platform also builds a dynamic evaluation model, which can provide personalized push of training resources based on learners' knowledge and skills mastery. The platform uses gamification simulation technology, combined with gamification elements such as confrontation, clearance, points, etc., which greatly stimulates learners' interest in learning. The research results of this article have been successfully applied in Anhui Electric Power Company. They have the characteristics of convenient use, high cost performance, and strong pertinence, and have yield good training results.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Energy Metering Collection and Detection Management by Computer Network Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Measurement data management is a very important part of energy saving and consumption reduction in enterprises. The comprehensiveness, timeliness, and accuracy of measurement data collection will directly affect the decision-making of production and the improvement of overall efficiency. However, in most energy-consuming enterprises, measurement data management will undoubtedly become a major and complex issue due to the complex production process, numerous measurement links, and great differences in the characteristics of various measurement media. In order to effectively exert the function of metering data management and create obvious economic benefits for enterprises, firstly, this work discusses the common equipment data collection content and Browser/server (B/S) architecture theory in comprehensive energy metering collection and testing management. Secondly, based on B/S architecture, computer network technology is used to establish a smart integrated energy measurement collection and detection management system. Finally, the energy consumption of the energy metering information network is analyzed under computer network technology. The results show that the comprehensive energy measurement by computer network technology is closer to the numerical range of actual energy collection results. The traditional energy measurement collection results and the actual energy measurement value range are larger, which is not conducive to the authenticity of the energy measurement collection data and the further energy detection and management of the enterprise. This work realizes the design of a comprehensive energy measurement collection and detection management system under the computer network technology, which will provide data support for enterprises to carry out comprehensive energy management.

Author Keywords: energy saving and consumption reduction management

articleTitle: Research on Decentralized Distributed Knowledge Graph Scheme Based on Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: the rapid growth of the scale of knowledge graph, the demands for constructing decentralized distributed knowledge graph are becoming more urgent. There are some attempts in this aspect. But there are still many challenges to be addressed: (1) Lack of a credible multi-party collaboration environment for distributed knowledge graph. (2) Lack of effective knowledge quantification and sharing incentives mechanism. In order to these two problems, we propose a framework and technical architecture of decentralized distributed knowledge graph based on blockchain in this paper. Then, we analyze the importance of contribution confirmation and quantification of knowledge, and propose the methods of knowledge quantification and sharing incentives in distributed knowledge graph. Finally, the future research direction of the scheme is proposed including more fine-gained value quantification, privacy security and blockchain performance optimization in decentralized distributed knowledge graph.

articleTitle: Research on the Professional Development of Leisure Sports under Computer Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This article builds a fitness training guidance system based on somatosensory games, connects the somatosensory game equipment XBOX with the health cloud service platform independently developed by the research group, and guides users to enjoy the effect of scientific fitness while having fun fitness. The system obtains the user's personalized fitness plan from the health cloud service platform through Web Service, and presents it on the terminal Android device. By customizing the communication protocol and using the Android serial port API to realize the serial communication technology under the Android device, the two-way video signal switching is completed, and the user is guided to carry out fitness training according to the game items and exercise parameters specified by the fitness plan, and the exercise results are uploaded to Health. Cloud service platform. The fitness system design method in this paper has a good effect on improving the entertainment and effectiveness of personal fitness, and has good generality.

articleTitle: Multi-target Search Using Teams of Robots Based on Thompson Sampling
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Different Solutions and algorithm to the Multi-Armed Bandit (MAB) problem using method of exploration and exploitation trade-off, including Thompson Sampling. Which proved to have competitive results compared to popular methods of solution. Formulated MAB problem into Multi-robot Search problem. Showed data solving multi-robot search problem with Dynamic Thompson sampling.

articleTitle: Health Status Evaluation of Bearing Based on DE-ELM
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Be directed against the nonlinear dynamic characteristics of bearing vibration signals and the low accuracy of reliability evaluation, a bearing health evaluation method based on extreme learning machine(ELM) optimized by differential evolution algorithm (DE-ELM) is proposed. Firstly, the vibration signal is preprocessed, and the importance of each feature is calculated by using the Gini coefficient in the random forest to select the time domain features and frequency domain features with high weight. Then the health status is divided by hierarchical clustering. Finally, the health status of bearing is evaluated by DE-ELM. DE-ELM not only has simple structure and fast convergence speed, but also can make up for the decline of classification accuracy of extreme learning machine, caused by the random generation of parameters. From experimental results, comparing with the traditional ELM model, the optimized model has higher classification accuracy and better health state recognition effect.

articleTitle: Deep Neural Networks for Detecting Hate Speech
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: With increased social media activity, hate speech on the Internet has become increasingly prevalent. It is a hazardous and damaging form of internet content that targets a group or individual based on their religion, race, or sexual orientation. As a result, it has garnered increasing attention from researchers. This article will examine current research trends, data sources, and methodologies and recommend future study directions. The subject of hate speech was determined at the start of 2020, and it includes attacks on minorities, religion, women, the general election agenda, and politics. Individuals have experimented with various methodologies and models and discovered several characteristics that fulfill the exclusion requirements. However, these methodologies and features do not imply that they will perform well in detecting hatred. The data collection, selected features, number of categories, and mutually exclusive categories all significantly impact the classification performance of hate speech.

articleTitle: Application of voice recognition control technology in wind power field operation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This paper designs a wind power equipment operation monitoring platform based on speech recognition, wind power equipment information collection module, information processing unit, central control room monitoring system, mobile monitoring system and remote terminal monitoring system. Compared with the current technical level, the interaction efficiency between the monitoring terminal and the wind turbine operation monitoring equipment solved by the new system is relatively weak, especially the interaction efficiency of the data obtained by the diagnostic personnel is relatively small. The reduction of interaction efficiency will eventually lead to the problem of the quality of wind power equipment operation guarantee.

articleTitle: Research on the Strategy of Automobile Software Test Case Generation Based on State Chart
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Software testing is one of the important means to ensure the quality of automotive software, and the completeness of the test case set is a key factor in software testing. This paper proposes a method for generating software test cases based on state diagram, it using the state chart and extended finite state machine to construct the test graph and study the test coverage path, the test case collection of the test coverage criterion can be obtained. The method can be used for unit testing and integration testing in the automotive software testing process, and the efficiency and accuracy of the method are verified by the test cases of actual automotive software.

articleTitle: Design and Manufacture of Concealed Steel Structure Damage Detection Robot
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Absrtact-At present, steel structure has been applied in many buildings in China, and has achieved good application effect, especially in the structure of some large construction projects. However, with the passage of time, different degrees of damage and disease will occur in steel structures. It is necessary to adopt the method of regular detection to master the degree and characteristics of steel structure damage so as to provide the basis for structural safety evaluation. At present, the steel structure damage detection instruments are mostly hand-held instruments, the detection operation can not be separated from manual hand-held operation, especially in the underground steel pipeline, underground steel structure and other hidden structure application is insufficient, the use of manual detection is quite inconvenient. Therefore, this paper proposes a kind of detection robot for concealed steel structure, which combines ultrasonic flaw detection instrument and robot to realize the unmanned field of steel structure flaw detection. The robot is used to detect the damage of underground concealed steel structure and steel structure with a certain height on the surface.

articleTitle: Optimum Selection Strategy of Time Domain Dielectric Response Characteristic Quantity of Transformer Oil-Paper Insulation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In the current research of oil-paper insulation diagnosis, there is no reasonable basis for selecting the time-domain dielectric characteristic space. A two-stage time-domain dielectric characteristic optimization strategy is proposed, which combines Pearson correlation coefficient and random forest importance estimation. Firstly, 23 kinds of time-domain feature quantities which have been studied are summarized, and the measured data of transformer are collected to complete feature extraction. Secondly, a feature selection strategy is proposed to determine the optimal feature space: the first level feature selection takes Pearson correlation coefficient as the index to eliminate highly redundant features; the second level feature selection uses random forest bag data for feature evaluation, eliminating less important features. Finally, a variety of algorithms are used for diagnostic experiments and comparative analysis. The results show that the optimal feature space proposed in this paper has stronger applicability in all diagnostic algorithms. The method proposed in this paper is feasible and effective for the optimization of dielectric characteristics in time domain.

articleTitle: Design of security platform based on cloud edge combined with machine vision
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of high delay, high bandwidth and low scalability of traditional security system based on deep learning, an extensible security platform design with edge side real-time reasoning is proposed to save bandwidth and computing resources. The design is based on smart chip technology and lightweight deep learning framework, design the fast inference and edge cloud training, intelligence analysis, management, system architecture, using the image optimization technology and large data distributed storage technology, to realize mass storage, video and image data effectively and efficiently design based on micro service business architecture, Service requirements such as monitoring scale expansion and personalized analysis are met. Experimental results show that the platform can significantly reduce intelligent reasoning delay, bandwidth and resource cost, and has scalability and practicability suitable for promotiont.

articleTitle: Offline Speech Recognition Technology of Mobile Terminal Based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Traditional speech recognition methods need to convert speech into text content before text recognition, which requires high computational power. Therefore, speech data is usually transmitted to back-end application recognition through the network. When sensitive information is involved, it also brings the risk of data leakage. To solve the above problems, intelligent terminal offline voice analysis is realized. Using acoustic model implementation, to avoid the risk of leakage in the process of data transmission, at the same time, the design fully combined with mobile terminal co., LTD is implementation, eliminating the process of the text to speech, directly in the aspect of phonetic pronunciation of words in speech characteristics, which can identify calculate power demand is low, faster recognition and the rarely used word and vague pronunciation with higher compatibility, Greatly improve the efficiency of speech recognition.

articleTitle: Experimental study on the life of fast repulsive mechanical switches
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Fast mechanical switch plays a key role in circuit breaker, but it is very easy to be damaged by the huge force, thus reducing the service life of fast mechanical switch. To address this problem, this paper first divides the design of the fast mechanical switch into three parts based on the body design, power supply design and control design, briefly analyzes the composition and technical parameters of the fast mechanical switch, develops the test prototype on this basis and gives the corresponding physical diagram, and finally conducts mechanical life experiments using the test prototype and verifies the design effect through three improvements. The results show that based on the 24kV fast mechanical switch test prototype, the life time of the fast mechanical switch can reach 1000 times when the operating mass of the fast repulsion mechanism is 7.5kg and the closing and breaking voltages are in the range of 1290V-1473V and 1096V-1251V respectively.

articleTitle: Research on the Quantitative Trading Strategy Based on Bollinger Band Strategy and Polynomial Regression Model
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: First, this paper made time-price line charts for gold and bitcoin and analyzed their primary trend of flat-rising. Subsequently, we established the Bollinger Bands strategy and a regression polynomial combinatorial model in Python to make the trade points precise. We import gold and bitcoin data into the model, respectively, and let it automatically perform graphing and data processing to obtain the fitting images, optimal fitting times, model coefficient list, and model intercept of the gold and bitcoin PR models. Afterward, we determined the trading conditions, stop-loss levels, and commissions and used the Bollinger Bands strategy to backtest the five-year trading to obtain the trading results of a single strategy. Based on the conservative principle of risk hedging and split-position trading, we reset the position distribution combined the Bollinger Bands strategy and the regression polynomial combination model into a comprehensive model. This paper plotted the fluctuations of gold and bitcoin in the time dimension. The comprehensive model shows the characteristics of high total return, low total transaction cost, and small maximum drawdown, which proves that the comprehensive model provides the best strategy.

articleTitle: Neural network-based optimization algorithm for intelligent manufacturing
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The development of China's manufacturing industry is slowing down, the reason is that the main body is still built by traditional skills as the core, and many industries are using traditional human resources, or carrying out repetitive mechanized work, which makes the manufacturing industry scale is huge but the degree of intelligence and automation is not high, and the manufacturing cost and revenue begin to imbalance. Therefore, it is the mainstream trend to promote the transformation of traditional manufacturing industry into intelligent manufacturing, and with the current development of artificial intelligence, more and more intelligent manufacturing technology is used in traditional manufacturing industry, and the research on neural network is getting deeper and deeper, and the field of machine learning is getting more and more mature. In this paper, on the basis of the main model of BP neural network, the optimization design is completed on the genetic algorithm, and a new optimization design algorithm is applied to the intelligent manufacturing industry to accelerate the transformation of the traditional manufacturing industry to the direction of intelligent manufacturing.

articleTitle: Analysis of Thermal and Electrolytic Coupling Characteristics of Typical Thermal Power Plants in China
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In order to improve the flexibility of the thermal power unit, improve the peak regulation and heat supply regulation capacity of the power plant, and promote the consumption of new energy, this paper takes a 350MW unit in China as the research object. 4 kinds of thermo-decoupling technical schemes, such as absorption heat pump and compression heat pump, are calculated to calculate the change of the maximum heat supply and electric load rate of the unit after thermo-decoupling of each scheme. The results show that after decoupling, the maximum heat supply of the units in each scheme can be increased by 174MW, 136.18MW, 168.37MW, and 38MW respectively; under the original maximum heat supply load, the minimum electrical load rate is reduced to 44.29%, 73.29%, 73.70<sup>%</sup>, and 80.57%. The low-pressure cylinder zero output technology has the best effect, the maximum heat supply of the unit is increased the most, and the electrical load rate is also reduced the most.

articleTitle: Design of PC monitoring system of the wind turbine simulator based on LabVIEW
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The wind turbine simulator consists of PC and slave computer jointly. The simulator can control the asynchronous motor to drive the generator output power according to the torque reference from the PC monitoring system to simulate the operation process of wind power generation in the laboratory. This paper adopts the LabVIEW language established PC monitoring system, through the internal mathematical model of a wind turbine, completed the conversion from the wind speed input to torque output, and sent down real-time torque command value to lower level computer through the serial port; meanwhile monitoring system can real-time display asynchronous motor running parameters and monitor the operation status of each module. Laboratory tests show that the PC monitoring system function achieved the design requirements.

articleTitle: Research on wood defect detection based on deep learning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Wood defects limit the efficient use of wood, but this problem can be effectively avoided through wood defect detection. This paper analyzes the traditional wood defect detection method and the wood defect detection method based on deep learning. It is found that the method based on deep learning avoids the drawbacks of the traditional wood defect detection method to a certain extent and is more efficient.

articleTitle: Computer Intelligent Evaluation Model and Characteristics of Spatiotemporal Pattern of Ecosystem Service Information Digitization in Shaanxi Province
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Shaanxi Province is located in the hinterland of China, in the important position of connecting China East, central region and northwest and southwest. This study is based on Shaanxi Province as the research area, combined with 2000, 2010 and 2018 land use / cover, quantitative assessment of ecological supply services, regulation services, support services, support services, and cultural services and its cold hot spot time and space. The results showed that: (1) 2000–2018, Shaanxi land use patterns changed, mainly as the forest area continued to increase, the area of cultivated land is slightly reduced, and the area of construction is increased faster; (2) 2000, 2010 and 2018 The total value of Shaanxi ecosystem services is 890.76 billion yuan, 913.88 billion yuan and 911.198 billion yuan, which are rising in fluctuations; (3) 2018, Yulin City is in the total value of the total value of ecosystem services; Hanzhong City and Ankang City is in Unit area value hotspot area. This study passed the scientific reference for future ecological planning through the analysis of the value of the ecosystem service in Shaanxi Province and its cold hot spot.

articleTitle: Information Visualization Technology and Mathematical Statistics Applied in the Research on Spatiotemporal Clustering and Changing of COVID-19
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: To analyze the epidemiological and distribution characteristics of COVID-19 in the United States from 2020.1 to 2021.8, which can provide scientific basis for the formulation of epidemic prevention measures. The incidence data of COVID-19 epidemic from 2020.1-2021.8 in the United States were collected for analysis, the spatial autocorrelation was analyzed by using Geoda 1.18.0, SaTScan 10.0 was used to conduct spatial scan statistics, and ArcGIS 10.4 were used to visualize. As of August 26, 2021, the epidemic in the United States is still in a state of high-speed transmission, and the number of cases is concentrated from November 2020 to February 2021 and August 2021; From the perspective of global spatial autocorrelation, COVID-19 in the United States has a high spatial aggregation, and the geographical spatial adjacency of each region has the greatest influence on the intensity of disease aggregation. According to the local spatial self-analysis, most of the agglomerations were in high-high and low-low clusters, and the high-high cluster states showed a patchy distribution, and experienced an increase-decrease-increase in number. According to the spatio-temporal scanning statistics, there were four clusters, of which the first cluster was located in the southeastern United States. In terms of t the mean center of infection, the epidemic moved greatly in the early stage and stabilized in the southeastern part of the United States in the later stage. COVID-19 in the United States has strong aggregation and changes over time. The focus of prevention and control is the southeast of the United States, and the focus of prevention and control is to reduce the population movement of adjacent states.

articleTitle: Research on 3D Intelligent System Based on Network Information Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In order to overcome the “semantic gap” and other problems faced by traditional video processing technologies, the information contained in the patio-temporal subspace of the 3D model is used for video processing and analysis, and an intelligent video surveillance technology guided by the spatiotemporal subspace of the 3D model is proposed. First, the 3D target model is matched from the video under the guidance of the body shape subspace. Secondly, we extract video events under the guidance of the patio-temporal subspace of the 3D model: surveillance object video + 3D model spatiotemporal subspace <tex>$\rightarrow 3\mathrm{D}$</tex> action of the surveillance object. Finally, the action comparison classification in our 3D event library: motion data + 3D event library <tex>$\rightarrow$</tex> video type and nature. Experimental simulation shows that the application of the three-dimensional intelligent panoramic monitoring system in the field of vehicle monitoring has achieved satisfactory results.

articleTitle: Research on the identification of the ancient building roof based on the object detection algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In recent years, the digital protection of ancient buildings based on modern technology has received more and more attention. The digital protection of ancient buildings and the establishment of the database can enhance the ability of ancient buildings to resist risks. However, the degree of automation in the process of database establishment is not high, which requires expert identification and statistics, which is time and force-consuming. Therefore, the construction of the automatic identification model of the roof of ancient buildings is of great significance for the maintenance and management, dating and three-dimensional reconstruction of ancient buildings. This paper develops a method for establishing the database of ancient building roof components, and develops a deep learning model framework based on the target detection algorithm to identify the specific types of ancient building roof. The automatic roof identification method proposed in this paper performs well in the hip roof, and the results can meet the needs of the roof digital protection and maintenance management.

articleTitle: An Internet of Things Data Compression Method Based on a Railway Project
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Due to the rapid development of the Internet of Things, monitoring sensors have become increasingly popular in railway construction. The project has relatively high requirements for real-time monitoring, data storage, and rapid display to ensure construction safety. Therefore, data compression is a fundamental issue regarding time series generated by a wide range of sensors. For sequential data, a reasonable compression method should possess the following characteristics: a high degree of data reduction, the preservation of local and global features, and rapid response to user requests. The computer performs better as a result of several features. This paper utilizes a piecewise approximation algorithm to encode sequential data without compression. Comparatively to coding compression, this method can process and display data more quickly, and the compression rate is as high as 24%.

articleTitle: Research on system construction under the operation mode of power grid cloud security management platform
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: A unified cloud management platform is the key to efficient and secure management of cloud computing resources. To improve the operation effect of the power cloud service platform, power companies can use the micro-service architecture technology to carry out data processing, information integration, and innovative functional architecture of the power cloud service platform, realize the optimal design of the power cloud service platform and improve the power cloud service platform-security service quality. According to the technical requirements of the power cloud security management platform, this paper designs the technical architecture of the power unified cloud security management platform and expounds on the functional characteristics of the cloud security management platform to verify the feasibility and effectiveness of the cloud security management platform.

articleTitle: Construction of 5G Protocol Knowledge Graph Based on Multi-relation and Sequential Chain
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: With the rapid development of 5G communication, the number of protocol specifications of different manufacturers, different equipment and different versions is not only increasing, but also the iteration update between versions is getting faster and faster, which puts forward higher requirements for network excellent personnel to quickly and skillfully master the communication specifications. The construction of knowledge maps for 5G communication protocols can help network personnel quickly obtain relevant protocols and indicators and their detailed information without the need for the full text of the general protocol. This paper proposes a knowledge graph construction method based on multiple relations and time-dependent chain, aiming at the iterativeness of communication specification protocol versions over time and the correlation between different indicators and protocols. The effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by comparing with the classical knowledge graph construction method in experiments.

articleTitle: IoT-Network Attack Detection with Optimized Recurrent Neural Network and Optimal Feature Selection
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) is rapidly expanding, allowing diverse internet-enabled gadgets to connect with one another in a variety of settings. Because of their scattered structure, Interconnects are vulnerable to a range of risks, including insider assaults. In addition, the Internet of Things (IoT) has expanded the number of heterogeneous systems connected to the Internet. This self-improved Whale Optimization Algorithm; (SI-WOA) is a conceptual improvement of standard WOA. The attack detection takes place via optimized Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) that is trained with the optimal features. Further, the weight of RNN is fine-tuned with the newly projected SI-WOA to enhance the detection accuracy. The outcome from optimized RNN is the final outcome that tells about the presence/ absence of attacks in the network. Finally, a comparative evaluation is done to validate the efficiency of the projected model.

articleTitle: Research on Digital Media art Model Based on Computer Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Based on computer big data technology, this paper proposes a design method of digital media recommendation system based on user behavior analysis and LDA model. Build a big data information collection and item distribution model for digital media recommendation, and use the method of association rule scheduling to extract the user behavior ontology features of digital media, and build a user behavior feature detection model for digital media recommendation. The paper first analyzes the similarity of digital media, and then establishes a user behavior feature extraction model on this basis. Secondly, the fuzzy decision scheduling of digital media is carried out in the LDA model, combined with the fuzzy C-means clustering algorithm to calculate the joint information entropy of digital media user behavior, and the digital media recommendation algorithm is optimized through the joint information entropy result. Compared with the traditional multimedia management mode, this system is more information-based and intelligent. The resource modules in the system cooperate with each other independently. Through the association and combination of modules, the business functions such as query, download and upload of multimedia resources can be realized.

articleTitle: A Study of Orphan Blocks in Public Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Orphan blocks are blocks mined by miner compliance but not confirmed by other peers. Major public blockchain systems such as Bitcoin and Ethereum face damage from orphaned blocks, and a low orphan block is a crucial metric for blockchains. In this work, we analyze the main factors of orphan block generation and survey the damage to orphaned blocks. We built a real environment of Ethereum in a local cluster to verify the percentage of orphan blocks in the PoW protocol. We observed that the highest rate of orphan blocks in nodes reached 81.91%, and 76.45% of all blocks mined by the cluster nodes were orphan blocks. Finally, we investigate the specific solutions to solve orphan blocks.

articleTitle: Leveling Strategy of Active Hydraulic Suspension System Based on GA-PID Controllers
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This paper introduces the hydraulic suspension system's optimized strategy based on the genetic algorithm. To adapt to the various road conditions, it can be reduced with the synchronization error between the independent suspensions by such an algorithmic controller and level the vehicle with a rapid speed. Optimized with the genetic PID algorithm, the process of leveling can realize the dynamic characteristic control. The co-simulation research was carried out and compared with the fuzzy-PID controller by establishing the hydraulic leveling circuit and the genetic PID optimization algorithm via AMESim and MATLAB/Simulink. The simulation tests eventually validate that the utilization of the PID controller with the genetic algorithm can effectively optimize leveling time of the vehicle and more accurately than the fuzzy PID controller.

articleTitle: Research on log data analysis technology based on improved Hadoop
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In view of the low computational efficiency of traditional log data analysis technology in processing large amounts of data, this paper proposes a set of log data analysis solutions based on big data technology. A parallel log analysis tool is designed on the Hadoop open source framework, and the anomaly detection of log data is implemented using the MapReduce model. Through experimental demonstration, when analyzing massive log data, the use of big data technology can significantly improve the execution efficiency of anomaly detection.

articleTitle: Research on the Optimal Route Recommendation Algorithm System for Automatic Driving by Computer Artificial Intelligence Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In order to meet the requirements of fast driving in a dynamic environment, the existing unmanned vehicles generally use the method of adding local planning between the two-layer structure (path planning {path tracking) of the traditional planning system. Obstacle avoidance to reduce time-consuming global path re-planning. Based on this research background, this paper studies the computational performance of the Multi-layer Grid Neighborhood A* algorithm (MSA*) and the neighborhood grid layer by performing path planning on a random map. impact on it. In the numerical experiment, the path planning is carried out from A* to the 8th floor MSA*, and the path planning results are compared and analyzed. The numerical test results show that the multi-layer A* algorithm can improve the automatic driving planning path of the A* algorithm, but it also increases the calculation time. Considering the calculation time and the planning path comprehensively, it is suggested that the 4-MSA * algorithm can be used in the actual vehicle autonomous driving path planning problem.

articleTitle: The Electrical Characteristics Test Parameters Model of Multi-output Low Dropout Voltage Regulators
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: By analyzing the function and electrical characteristics of multi-output low dropout voltage regulators, a reusable multi-output low dropout voltage regulators model is constructed combined with automatic test equipment hardware resources, so that in the process of developing the electrical characteristic parameter test programs of such devices based on automatic test equipment, the goal of rapid development of software program is achieved by matching this model, and the development cost is saved.

articleTitle: Failure Risk Assessment of Functional Modules of Shipboard Equipment Based on Data Fusion
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In view of the difficulties in assessing the failure risk of shipborne equipment, the focus of risk prevention is only determined by job experience, and the lack of quantitative decision support for equipment preventive maintenance and spare parts procurement and storage, a data fusion-based research on the failure risk assessment of shipborne equipment functional modules has been carried out. On the basis of comprehensive consideration of the signal transmission process of the shipboard equipment system, the proportion of spare parts reserve, historical failure conditions, condition monitoring methods and other factors, the genetic algorithm-based equipment function module failure risk assessment model was constructed, and the model was verified through examples. And the feasibility and rationality of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Experimental study of reverse reconstruction for transformer radiation noise based on ARMA model
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Based on the acoustic radiation theory and laser vibration measurement method, the surface vibration and radiation noise sound pressure of the dry-type transformer model are measured experimentally, and the frequency response function method and surface vibration velocity method are used to obtain the radiation exponent of the transformer, respectively. On this basis, the autoregressive moving average model (ARMA) is used to study the reverse reconstruction of transformer noise, and the predicted values of sound pressure and sound pressure level are obtained and compared with the experimental values. The results show that the radiation exponent obtained by the frequency response function method is slightly smaller than that of the surface vibration method by about 1~1.5 dB. The difference between the sound pressure obtained by the noise prediction algorithm based on the ARMA model and the experimental test sound pressure is about 0.015 Pa, and the difference in sound pressure level is about 1 dB. The prediction algorithm based on ARMA model and laser vibration measurement for reverse reconstruction of noise has good feasibility and can be applied to prediction of radiated noise of other structures.

articleTitle: Research on Network Confrontation Information Security Protection System under Computer Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Aiming at the single hopping strategy in the terminal information hopping active defense technology, a variety of heterogeneous hopping modes are introduced into the terminal information hopping system, the definition of the terminal information is expanded, and the adaptive adjustment of the hopping strategy is given. A network adversarial training simulation system is researched and designed, and related subsystems are discussed from the perspective of key technologies and their implementation, including interactive adversarial training simulation system, adversarial training simulation support software system, adversarial training simulation evaluation system and adversarial training Mock Repository. The system can provide a good environment for network confrontation theory research and network confrontation training simulation, which is of great significance.

articleTitle: Research on thin film solar cell: Principal and parameters
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This article introduces 3 typical thin film solar cells (CdTe/Cds, Amorphous and CIGS). The basic structures of these solar cells are presented. Thin film solar cells are a promising choice for companies which has a large usage of solar cells. The rising efficiency of thin film solar cells also gets a lot of attention. By comparing parameters of some newest thin film solar cells, this article can provide a reference for companies which are interested in using thin-film solar cells.

articleTitle: Simulation Analysis of Tracking and Control Link Level in Launch Vehicle Based on STK
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The target feature analysis is essential for sea based launch vehicle tracking and control. The analysis method is performed with recognizing gain changes of telemetry antenna pattern in task usually and computing the automatic gain control (AGC) signal received by TT &C station manually. Aiming at the problems of low efficiency, complicated process and human errors, the method is discussed for a simulation analysis of tracking and control link level in launch vehicle based on STK, which elaborated emphatically for generating the electromagnetic field radiation pattern accord with STK format by launch vehicle antenna pattern. Compare the results of simulation and actual tracking by the launch vehicle in a flying, it indicates that the proposed method can satisfy the requirement in task and the result of simulation can be the reference by target feature analysis on launch vehicle.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of low phase noise 100MHz TCXO based on phase locked method
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The rapid development of electronic technology calls for high frequency, low phase noise and high stability of temperature compensated crystal oscillator (TCXO). This paper describes the design and implementation of high-frequency TCXO based on phase-locked method for solving the current TCXO industry pain points such as phase noise, compensation accuracy and mass production. Firstly, this paper establishes the theoretical noise model of phase locked loop. Then, by using phase locked loop to lock a low phase noise voltage controlled crystal oscillator (VCXO) to reference input signal which is generated by a 10MHz TCXO, a low phase noise 100MHz TCXO have been designed and realized. The frequency shift is ±0.28ppm(@-40°C~+85°C); and the phase noise is ≤ -117dBc/Hz@100Hz, ≤ -153dBc/Hz@lkHz, ≤ -171dBc/Hz@10kHz, ≤ -176dBc/Hz@100kHz respectively. Experimental results show that the low phase noise 100MHz TCXO implemented in this way has good frequency-temperature characteristics, excellent phase noise performance, and easy mass production as well.

articleTitle: Research on the Application Design of Computer Virtual Reality Technology in Animation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Unity3D is a cross-platform game development engine, and its built-in application programming interface (API) functions combined with Visual Studio development tools can efficiently develop visual simulation systems. The purpose of educational games is to meet the psychological needs of players, and at the same time, the desire for satisfaction that players expect to achieve is transformed into the motivation to learn the educational content, and the learning effect is used as a channel to realize the satisfaction of psychological needs, which is a kind of psychological needs. The process of transforming with learning motivation. Based on the EGL framework and with the help of the Unity3D engine technology, this paper developed a 3D version of the animal kingdom roaming learning game.

articleTitle: Defect detection algorithm for chain saw chain production line based on deep learning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: With the rapid development of my country's manufacturing industry, the requirements for traditional manufacturing processes are becoming more and more stringent. Among them, the chain saw as a saw is a portable logging machine that uses a combination of a small internal combustion engine and a runner, and uses fuel as an energy source to drive the internal combustion engine to drive the flywheel to rotate and drive through the chain drive. Because of its portability, efficiency and high reliability, it is more and more popular with loggers all over the world. The chain saw chain is the core component of the chain saw, and its quality determines the service life of the chain saw. This paper combines the current mainstream artificial intelligence technology and applies it to the defect detection of chain saw chains, and proposes a deep learning-based defect detection algorithm for chain saw chain production lines. The production quality of the saw chain.

articleTitle: Research on the application of computer VR technology in 3D printing creative product design of pottery
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The cultural and creative design of ceramic products should be in line with modern life. The design object is the product, but the purpose of the design is not the product, but to meet the needs of people, that is, the design is for people. Design can be said to be the product of human needs, the product of satisfying human needs for products and other non-products. The purpose of cultural and creative design of ceramic products is not only the expression of cultural and creative design, but also the practicability and demand of products. Therefore, the cultural and creative design of ceramic products must conform to modern life. The application of VR interactive technology in ceramic design and production is a new breakthrough in the participation of large-scale machines. This paper designs a ceramic sculpture system by using VR interactive virtual technology and JAVA platform. The system includes template management, sketch management and specification management, and provides basic data for design and testing modules. Through high-quality design algorithms of free-form surfaces and curves, innovative design of ceramic shapes and textures can be promoted; in the new development of VR technology in ceramic design, computer-aided design has successfully solved the design and drawing of various drawings in ceramic design. The VR simulation The training system has a sense of immersion and high interaction efficiency, which improves the training efficiency of teaching practice.

articleTitle: Research on Enterprise Information Security Risk Assessment System Based on Bayesian Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Information security construction is a social issue, and the most urgent task is to do an excellent job in information risk assessment. The bayesian neural network currently plays a vital role in enterprise information security risk assessment, which overcomes the subjective defects of traditional assessment results and operates efficiently. The risk quantification method based on fuzzy theory and Bayesian regularization BP neural network mainly uses fuzzy theory to process the original data and uses the processed data as the input value of the neural network, which can effectively reduce the ambiguity of language description. At the same time, special neural network training is carried out for the confusion that the neural network is easy to fall into the optimal local problem. Finally, the risk is verified and quantified through experimental simulation. This paper mainly discusses the problem of enterprise information security risk assessment based on a Bayesian neural network, hoping to provide strong technical support for enterprises and organizations to carry out risk rectification plans. Therefore, the above method provides a new information security risk assessment idea.

articleTitle: Design of a chaotic sequence cipher algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: To protect the security of video information use encryption technology to be effective means. In practical applications, the structural complexity and real-time characteristics of video information make the encryption effect of some commonly used algorithms have some shortcomings. According to the characteristics of video, to design practical encryption algorithm is necessary. This paper proposed a novel scheme of chaotic image encryption, which is based on scrambling and diffusion structure. Firstly, the breadth first search method is used to scramble the pixel position in the original image, and then the pseudo-random sequence generated by the time-varying bilateral chaotic symbol system is used to transform each pixel of the scrambled image ratio by ratio or encryption. In the simulation experiment and analysis, the performance of the encrypted image message entropy displays that the new chaotic image encryption scheme is effective.

articleTitle: Insulator Defect Detection Method Based on Target Feature Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: A method for detecting insulator defects using images captured by drones is proposed, which can effectively detect defects in insulators on power lines. In this paper, YOLOV5 is used as the main frame to detect the defective parts of insulators. Because the defective parts of insulators are small and inconspicuous, a Target Feature Enhancement module(TFEM) is proposed to weaken the background information, enhance the target information to improve the expression of features and ability to detect insulator defects. The experimental results indicate that the proposed method can availably detect the defect sites of insulators.

articleTitle: Research on the lightweight design of Baja racing skeleton based on finite element analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In this paper, the finite element model of Baja racing car is constructed based on finite element analysis, the three-dimensional geometric model of the frame is established, the skeleton is appropriately simplified, the boundary conditions and loads are set, and then the skeleton of Baja off-road racing car is constructed. At the same time, this paper carries out the lightweight design of the body skeleton based on the approximate model method, and then obtains the optimal solution for each design variable. The lightweight design of the skeleton is based on the rational material selection, welding process, finite element mesh accuracy and the prediction accuracy of the approximation model, and the lightweight goal is achieved.

articleTitle: Mathematical Model of Relationship Between Power Data and Market Transformation and Upgrading Based on Data Mining Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: China's power companies have always been trading groups with huge growth potential. In the current uncertain market environment, the opportunities and threats brought about by market transformation are testing power companies. Traditional power companies have strong technical accumulation and technological innovation is also at the forefront of the industry. However, as the market changes, more and more companies are facing development difficulties. Pure technological innovation can no longer adapt to the current market environment. Only when a company develops a new business model in business can it make good use of its own resources and strength so as not to be eliminated by the market. The new environment creates new opportunities: How to transform and upgrade enterprises has become a problem in the current academic community. The purpose of this article is to study the relationship model between power data and market transformation and upgrading. This article analyzes in detail what data mining is and the impact of the transformation and upgrading of China's electricity market. Based on the data and cases in the references, the calculation method of data simulation is determined, and it is concluded that the electricity market will change after the corresponding upgrade and transformation. The result of getting more prosperous can stimulate the rise of small and medium-sized power generation companies, and those large power generation companies will improve their services and efficiency accordingly based on their own advantages. In order to prove the authenticity and reliability of this article, experiments and comparisons are carried out on the data in the references, which proves the authenticity and validity of this article. Experimental research shows that in the research on the relationship between power data and market transformation and upgrading based on data mining technology proposed in this paper, first obtain data from the Internet and reference documents, and then compare and analyze the data. It is found that in the early 21st century, China The power generation of China mainly relies on one-time energy sources such as coal, and the power generation accounts for about 74.5<sup>%</sup> of the total power generation. After the corresponding market transformation, upgrading and reform, this proportion has dropped to about 60% in recent years, and it is still falling further. Turning to clean energy development and progress, the proportion is getting higher and higher.

articleTitle: Research of Online Teaching System Based on PAR Platform and Cross-Media Algorithm Programming
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Online education promotes the reform of education model and provides a technical platform for education network. This paper takes the ideological and political online teaching design of algorithm programming as an example. By applying cross-media composition technology, most of the learning resources are stored as multimedia in the multimedia database on the server or in the cloud, and are waiting to be called in the form of Web services. In the process of creating ideological and political online courses, the cognitive modules of the course are combined in the form of services, and based on the interconnection of different multimedia teaching resources, the multimedia resources related to knowledge points are combined in the form of Web service reorganization, and assisted with the related web services of the online PAR platform, the effect of online ideological and political teaching is finally close to the teaching level of offline teachers.

articleTitle: A Novel Nonlinear Chaotic Mapping Based on Cosine-Exponent
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Chaotic systems have been widely used in many fields such as information encryption and complex signal modulation in recent years, because of the initial conditions sensitivity in the chaotic systems and the pseudo-randomness of chaotic sequences. Aiming at the problems of low complexity and low randomness of typical one-dimensional chaotic mapping, a new chaotic mapping based on cosine and exponential function is designed in this paper. Simulation results show that the randomness, complexity and balance of the new chaotic map are better than those of the typical one-dimensional chaotic map. And it has a good application prospect.

articleTitle: User Angle Estimation Based on Intelligent Reflecting Surface Assisted Communication
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This paper analyzes and solves the problem of estimating the user's angle under the condition that there is no line-of-sight (LoS) communication link between the base station (BS) and the user, and multiple intelligent reflecting surfaces (IRS) are used to assist communication. According to the established communication model, the appropriate passive beam vector is obtained by simulation analysis. After that, the area where the user is located is determined by using the transmission delay parameter of the received signal, and then the estimated area is finely divided. Based on sparse optimization knowledge, a second-order cone (SOC) programming problem is established, which is solved using the optimization toolbox and a graph of the simulation results is obtained. The simulation results show that when the LoS communication link between the BS and the user is missing, the position angle of the user can be effectively estimated based on the IRS-assisted communication. At the same time, increasing the number of IRSs in the communication system can improve the estimation accuracy.

articleTitle: Analysis of Circuit Characteristics of Double Memristors Based on Active Magnetic Memristor
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: To further study the dynamic characteristics of magnetic memristors and reduce the observation difficulty of chaotic phenomena. The design based on Chua's circuit, traditional Chua's diode is replaced by active magnetic memristors, resistor is replaced by magnetic memristors, and two ends of the inductance are connected in series with resistor, double memristor circuit based on active magnetic memristors is proposed. Dynamic characteristics of the circuit system are analyzed, the system dynamics analysis under different parameters is obtained. Design is more conducive to circuit realization, and enriches the research field of memristor dynamics system.

articleTitle: Development of smart trading strategy system based on computer dynamic prediction models and algorithm optimization
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Balancing the relationship between investment risk and return to formulate trading strategies has become an urgent problem in the capital market. In the study, by analyzing the historical price data of gold and bitcoin from 2016 to 2021, the time series method combined with a simple moving average method was introduced to develop price prediction models of gold and bitcoin in the next trading day, accurate predictions of future price for both financial products were completed. Based on this, by comparing the prices of gold and bitcoin two days before and after, six trading types of their asset portfolios were determined, and an optimal decision-making model was established to provide investors with the best daily trading strategy. Furthermore, the sensitivity under different transaction costs was tested by defining the sensitivity of trading strategies to transaction costs. Research informs investors on how to invest for the best returns.

articleTitle: Multi-state operation platform and scenario analysis of low-voltage distribution network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The multi-state operating environment and scenarios of low-voltage distribution network are analyzed. The multi-state operating conditions and influencing factors of low-voltage distribution network are described. The application of the intelligent gateway IoT platform in the low-voltage distribution network multi-state operation is analyzed, the low-voltage distribution multi-state operation platform is established, and the platform system structure and platform deployment method are given. Combined with the multi-state operation scenarios of the low-voltage distribution network, the analysis is carried out, and the specific applications of the integrated energy service platform, cloud service system, smart car networking., multi-station integration., fault options and other scenarios are explained.

articleTitle: Research on Text Naming Recognition Algorithm Based on Text Mining
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In the process of scientific research, the naming of Chinese texts is very critical, which often affects scholars' cognition and judgment of things, and also has a certain impact on a series of operations such as experiments. On the other hand, in the process of professional research, many uncommon words often need to be verified by retrieving the corresponding knowledge system. The naming and recognition of these specialized words are very difficult, and there are many complex problems, such as polysemy and the nesting of wings. Therefore, under the above background conditions, this paper uses text mining method to conduct related research on the text naming of scientific research objects and uses the text mining method to construct and improve the text naming recognition algorithm accordingly. The support vector machine method and neural network model are used to build a text naming method suitable for Chinese, and good results are obtained in the application process.

articleTitle: Research on Transformer Oil Dielectric Loss Live Detection System Based on Intelligent Internet of Things Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This paper analyzes the spectral properties of Blackman self-convolution windows. At the same time, a blackman self-convolution window bispectrality interpolation FFT based on the computer intelligent Internet of things technology is proposed for the dielectric loss angle charged detection algorithm, and the calculation formula of the dielectric loss angle is deduced in detail. Finally, the computer is used for simulation verification. The results show that the algorithm It can effectively improve the measurement accuracy of the dielectric loss angle.

articleTitle: Research on Volleyball Drop Trajectory Model Based on Computer Big Data
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: A mathematical model is established for the actual trajectory of the volleyball. This paper analyzes the impact of the ball after hitting the ball from different directions and angles, and obtains the range of the hitting angle of the ball that falls into the hard-to-defense area after being hit. In this paper, qualitative analysis and the free fall of the ball in the vertical direction are used, and then the operation of the ball after being hit is analyzed from the whole. In this paper, the Lagrange conditional extremum method is used to obtain the optimal angle range of the shot. This paper uses the mathematical software maple8 and matlab6.5 to solve the problem through the specific actual data in the volleyball game. The study found the optimal direction of hitting the ball.

articleTitle: Intelligent mask recognition and voice dialogue system based on Raspberry Pi control
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: As New Coronavirus continues to mutate, virulence and infectivity are constantly strengthened. 2019-nCoV has become the most deadly virus in recent years. Its main transmission route is droplet transmission. Wearing masks can effectively block the spread of viruses. Mask is an important defense line to prevent respiratory infectious diseases, which can reduce the risk of New Coronavirus infection. The mask can not only prevent the patient from spraying droplets and reduce the amount and speed of droplets.but also block the droplet core containing virus and prevent the wearer from inhaling. In public places.especially in places with large passenger flow, it is a drop in the bucket to rely solely on manual supervision of customers wearing masks. In order to solve this problem.an intelligent mask detection system is designed, It supports the corresponding models of all mainstream frameworks for face mask detection (pytorch, tensorflow, keras,mxnet and cafe) (the model trained by keras and other framework models converted),and provides the reasoning code of all five frameworks. At the same time.it also has the voice dialogue function,which can wake up the voice robot in real time and achieve man-machine communication. Let inspectors feel more at ease and consumers feel more at ease.

articleTitle: Optimization of K-means algorithm and its application in airline industry customer segmentation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The income of airlines comes from passengers. At present, in order to compete for passengers, various preferential marketing strategies emerge in endlessly, but only marketing products that meet the needs of passengers can really get the favor of passengers. Cluster analysis can realize customer segmentation, while the traditional K-means algorithm is widely used because of its simple algorithm, fast calculation speed and low requirements for hardware. However, the selection of K value cannot be accurately grasped, and the random selection of clustering center and other shortcomings are also prominent. Based on this, this paper improves the traditional K-means algorithm. Han-kmeans algorithm is proposed, and experiments prove that Han-Kmeans algorithm has higher clustering accuracy. Finally, this paper subdivides aviation industry customers through the improved algorithm, and puts forward targeted marketing strategies for different types of customers.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of a backend management system for green packaging products based on B/S architecture
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In view of the rapid development of green packaging products and the gradual expansion of demand, the online sales channels of green packaging products are crucial to the manufacturers of green packaging products. In response to this situation, this paper designs a backend management system for green packaging products based on B/S architecture, which can make statistics and display the operation and sales status of the online channels of the products, and store, modify and display the relevant data information of the products, laying the data foundation for the online sales strategy of green packaging products and making certain contributions to the development of green packaging products.

articleTitle: The Application of Data Mining Algorithm in the Legal Protection of Personal Data
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Although big data has brought great convenience to human life, the crime of network user data interests is becoming more and more important. There are growing calls for legal protection of personal data. The purpose of this paper is to study the application of legal protection of human data based on data mining algorithms. The principle and process of data mining and Apriori algorithm are analyzed, and then several classification standards of privacy-preserving algorithms oriented to data mining are introduced. From the perspective of legal protection, the role of legal protection of personal data is introduced in detail. The process of privacy protection algorithm in frequent pattern mining is clearly analyzed. On this basis, the noise addition method is introduced into standard mining protection privacy protection, and the noise data and the amount of noise data are described in detail. When the things in the original data set When the number is 20, the execution time is 1052. This method can effectively improve the effectiveness of the frequent pattern mining privacy algorithm.

articleTitle: Analysis of the whole process temperature field of RC beam and column transfer joint under fire
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In this paper, the ABSQUS soft ware is used to analyze the temperature field of the whole process of heating and cooling of the RC beam column transfer joint. The results show that the variation trend of simulated temperature field is similar to that of the experiment, the highest temperature of the measurement point all appears after cease-fire, and the temperature lag degree of different measurement points is different. By comparing the temperature fields of simulated and measured measuring points, it is found that the temperature of measuring points close to the specimen surface is in good agreement, but the temperature of measuring points inside is different to some extent.

Author Keywords: RC beam and column transfer joint
temperature field of the whole process of heating and cooling

articleTitle: Double quintic polynomial ecological lane change trajectory optimization for intelligent vehicles based on multi-objective genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This paper aims to study the ecological trajectory optimization of intelligent vehicle during lane change, so as to realize the energy saving and emission reduction of vehicle lane change process. Based on VT-Micro model and double quintic polynomial lane-changing trajectory algorithm, multi-objective genetic algorithm was used to calculate the eco-type vehicle speed trajectory during lane-changing. The feasibility of eco-lane-change trajectory optimization was verified by Matlab and Carsim co-simulation.
