The traditional financial measurement method is unable to capture the nonlinear of financial markets, multi-scale features, complex data, statistical machine learning needs a lot of expert knowledge, the artificial intervention, we choose the suitable for time series data in depth study of LSTM price prediction, and to prevent noise interference of financial data, we propose a VMD-LSTM prediction model. That is, THE IMF extracted from VMD decomposition and reflecting the internal law of the market is directly used as the feature for LSTM prediction.

articleTitle: Research on Forest Sustainable Development Intelligent Information Management System Based on ARIMA and MDP
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Forests absorb and sequestrate vast amounts of carbon dioxide. It greatly maintains a benign balance of greenhouse gases. Besides carbon sequestration value, forests also play an important role in economic development and many other aspects. To better understand a forest's capabilities and potential, a forest change prediction model was established based on ARIMA. We predict carbon sequestration and economic capabilities of forests for the next 100 years. Surprisingly, it was found that both of them have their thresholds, so a transitioning point was obtained with different standing stock reserves as the boundary. We provide 3 harvest plans for the different needs of forest managers: economical, environmentally friendly, and comprehensive. In order to better manage forests, we have established a forest sustainable development management strategy model based on the Markov decision process (MDP). It helps us find out what transition strategy would be optimal when the forest harvest schedule was changed to once a decade. The data come from the prediction results of forest change prediction model. We used the DQN algorithm to train the model for 3000 episodes, and take Sweden as an example to give a hundred-year best harvesting scheme suitable for three strategies.

articleTitle: Dataset for assessing the definition of underwater images
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: in recent years underwater image quality evaluation methods have been proposed. These methods aim to measure the performance of underwater image enhancement and recovery methods. Image datasets provide a basis for researchers to evaluate image processing algorithms and to adapt their structure. The work presented in this paper is different and aims to evaluate image algorithms in terms of both definition and overall perception. We propose a dataset in which we score our image datas in terms of definition and overall perception by subjective evaluating. Afterwards, we evaluate the performance of recent image quality evaluation methods by looking at these two aspects and find the superiority of using definition alone as index for evaluating.

articleTitle: A topology identification method of low-voltage distribution network based on structured manifold and density peaks clustering
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The consumer-transformer and consumer-phase relationships in low voltage distribution networks (LVDN) are often wrong and change frequently. A topology identification method of LVDN based on the structured manifold and density peak clustering (SM-DPC) is proposed. The method contains two stages, feature selection and feature clustering. In the feature selection stage, the structured manifold learning algorithm is used to compute the low-dimensional graph embedding of voltage data, which reduces feature redundancy and maintains the original arbitrary distribution features. In the feature clustering stage, based on the feature selection results, the topology identification is achieved by clustering similar low-dimensional manifolds in the same cluster and different low-dimensional manifolds in other clusters through the density peak clustering algorithm (DPC). The example results show that the SM-DPC is more accurate in discovering clustering centers than the original DPC algorithm, and can improve the accuracy of clustering where the data distribution presents arbitrary shapes. Therefore, the proposed topology identification method has higher accuracy for recognizing consumer-transformer and consumer-phase relationships in LVDN.

articleTitle: A Unified Framework for Super-Resolution Based on Segmentation-Prior and Self-Attention
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) is intensively applied to super-resolution (SR) task because of its superior performance. However, the problem of SR task is still challenging due to the lack of prior knowledge and small receptive field of CNN. We propose a unified framework for single image SR based on segmentation-prior and self-attention, named Segmentation-Prior Self-Attention Generative Adversarial Network (SPSAGAN). This combination is led by a carefully designed weighted addition to balance the influence of feature and segmentation attentions. Thus, the SPSAGAN can emphasize textures in the same segmentation category and meanwhile focus on the long-distance feature relationship. Extensive experiments show that SPSAGAN can generate more realistic and visually pleasing textures compared to state-of-the-art SFTGAN [1] and ESRGAN [2] on OST and BSD100 datasets

articleTitle: Dynamic Time-History Analysis of Base Isolation Structure Based on Integral Differential Method
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The structural dynamic time-history integral differential method is a high-order dynamic time-history analysis method for multi-degree-of-freedom (MDOF) damping systems with high computational efficiency. In this paper, the integral method is applied to the calculation of the dynamic time-history analysis of the base isolation structure. The upper structure of the base isolation system adopts the inter layer shear model, the isolation layer adopts the double tangent model, and the equation of motion is transformed into an equation of state. Using the integral method to make the whole process behave as a series of matrix multiplications and recursive calculations, without solving equations and additional interpolation, the dynamic response obtained accurately converges, and the calculation efficiency is high. Then, taking a seven story reinforced concrete frame structure with laminated rubber bearing base isolation in Lanzhou City, Gansu Province as an example, according to the isolation design parameters of the building, a calculation program is compiled based on the integral calculus method of dynamic time history analysis to analyze the dynamic response under rare earthquakes, which further verifies the applicable effect of the integral differential method of time-history analysis in engineering practice.

articleTitle: Multi-Objective Optimal Scheduling of Reservoirs Integrating the Internet of Things and Deep Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: With the continuous upgrading and expansion of the concept and technology of the Internet of Things (IoT), the production methods of many traditional industries have undergone earth-shaking changes. IoT and Differential Evolution Algorithm (DEA) are integrated into the deep learning model for multi-objective optimal scheduling of reservoirs. Firstly, based on IoT, a multi-objective optimal dispatching system and a wireless sensor network module for the reservoir are designed, which are mainly used to collect and process data. Secondly, a constraint system that comprehensively considers the reservoir water balance and other aspects are proposed. A certain reservoir group is taken as the research object, combined with the collected information of the reservoir groups in previous years. The ecological dispatch is studied to ensure the ecological flow of 60m<sup>3</sup>/s, and the preparation and calculation of the monthly and ten-day water dispatch plans for normal and low water levels are realized. The dispatching results confirm that the ecological dispatching scheme of this reservoir group has high operability and reliability in practice.

articleTitle: Detection Method of Early Data Based on SVM Classifier
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Alzheimer's disease is a common neurodegenerative disease in the elderly, and timely detection and treatment at the early-stage of the disease can prevent from worsening and promote recovering. Traditional Alzheimer's disease detection methods are costly and technically difficult to achieve. This project mainly explores a method for detecting early Alzheimer's disease based on plasma protein and support vector machine. The specific process is to collect human plasma protein data, extract features and classify it through support vector machine, thereby Check whether it has an early-stage disease. This method has certain advantages over traditional methods in terms of detection cost, accuracy, and difficulty of implementation.

articleTitle: User Price Elasticity Analysis Based on Power Load Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Mastering user price elasticity is an important basis for developing and utilizing demand-side resources and promoting efficient participation of demand-side resources in market transactions. However, the impact of load characteristics on electricity price elasticity has not been studied in depth in related researches. Based on the research on the load characteristics of industrial, commercial, residential and public buildings, this paper analyzes the price elasticity of the corresponding categories of users based on the load characteristics. The study found that the price elasticity of four types of electricity users including industrial, commercial, residential, and public buildings is different, and the price elasticity of different sub-loads within each is also different. Among them, the industrial sector has higher price elasticity in peak-off load and continuous load; the price elasticity of air-conditioning equipment load in the commercial sector is higher; the overall price elasticity of residential load is lower, but with the increase in the proportion of electricity consumption in the future, the market and technology Affected by factors such as the improvement of support, the price elasticity will be improved.

articleTitle: Condition Evaluation of Smart Electric Energy Meter Integrated with Computer Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This work is aimed to solve the resource waste caused by smart energy meters, from the condition evaluation of smart energy meters. Although the large amount of data collected by State Grid Corporation of China cover the information required for condition evaluation, there are many interference data. To solve this issue, a condition evaluation method of smart energy meters is proposed under selective ensemble, directing at the poor generalization ability of a single classifier and low efficiency and waste of resources caused by multiple classifiers. This method trains the same classification algorithm for many times, and utilizes the K-means algorithm as the selection strategy. In the method, the coincidence error of two classifiers is adopted as the standard for distance measurement, and the classifiers that produce consistent errors are divided into the same group. The number of selected classifiers is determined through experiments, and finally a vote is conducted on the classification results of the selected classifiers. The experimental results suggest that the selective ensemble method further improves the accuracy of classification and deserves an application value.

articleTitle: Research of curve fitting method combined with LPR based on attention mechanism
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: With the continuous deepening of interest rate market reform, how to break through the blockage of market interest rate transmission to loan interest rates has become a new challenge for fund transfer pricing. A single combination of loan interest rates and market interest rates tends to ignore their respective problems. At present, LPR interest rates are difficult to form a good interaction with policy interest rates. At the same time, the high volatility of market interest rates cannot adapt to the cost of deposits and loans. Therefore, we eliminates the high volatility peaks of market interest rates, and integrates market interest rates and LPR interest rates through a neural network model to construct an internal fund transfer pricing benchmark curve. Commercial banks can make adjustments based on their own development needs and give full play to the role of FTP in the transmission of interest rates.

articleTitle: Research and design of green packaging product recommendation system based on multi-algorithm fusion
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: With the deepening of green concept and the booming development of Internet technology, the market demand for green packaging products is gradually increasing, and the development of relevant recommendation systems for such products is also needed. Based on multi-algorithm fusion technology and data mining technology, this paper provides certain solution ideas to solve the common information overload problem in the recommendation system. At the same time the recommendation system can convert the purchasing power of users on the one hand, on the other hand can provide users with a basis for decision making, the recommendation system provides users with a better shopping experience, and also lays a certain theoretical and design foundation for the research and development of the recommendation system.

articleTitle: Research on key technologies of network education intelligent information system based on blockchain technology
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Most of the existing teaching management systems are implemented based on the traditional B/S architecture. Their functions are concentrated on the central server, and the administrator authority is too concentrated, so it may cause private tampering of data. At the same time, such systems are not conducive to multi-party authentication and query. Therefore, the existing teaching management system cannot well adapt to the new teaching method. This paper mainly conducts systematic research and analysis on the specific application of blockchain in educational information. From the perspective of blockchain education database, it conducts a specific study on its system design and educational information flow process. It ensures that the system data will not be maliciously queried and the management authority is dynamically changed, which ensures the security of the online education system, and improves the credibility of the learning process, mutual recognition of achievements and certificate information.

articleTitle: Application Research of Computer Big Data Technology in Monitoring Intelligent Terminal of Urban Power Distribution System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Aiming at the problems existing in the operation of the existing distribution network related information system, a set of distribution network integrated monitoring platform is constructed. The platform collects data from the existing distribution automation system, GIS system, and load control system, and integrates the scattered data of each system into a unified distribution network model after data processing. Based on the micro-service architecture, a set of upper-layer applications with various business functions can be flexibly expanded. Users can view real-time data and key indicators of distribution network operation on the platform and perform statistical analysis to further improve the level of distribution network operation and maintenance management.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Computer Artificial Intelligence Technology in Bank Financial Risk Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: At present, the daily transaction volume of major domestic banks is nearly 10 million, and the average daily transaction volume exceeds 100 billion yuan. A large amount of structured and unstructured transaction data is generated, which is difficult to effectively manage. At the same time, criminal methods are constantly being renovated, resulting in increasing number of crimes and more obviously negative impact on the banking industry. How to deal with massive amounts of data and respond to risks in a timely manner poses a great challenge to the implementation of the risk supervision system. According to the plan, the article describes the system's business design to the system's model network security and other requirements in detail. We put forward a system design based on bank risk warning and supervision, using semantic trees to describe in detail the functional design of the system, ETL technology for real-time management of data information, and UML modeling for supervision and warning management. The paper also describes the specific implementation of the bank risk warning and supervision system and some Java core codes. Finally, the system was tested and applied.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Computer Virtual Reality Technology in the Creation of Film and Video Animation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: 3D film and video animation, as a type of film and video animation with strong visual impact and realistic effect, has been paid more and more attention in the field of computer film and video animation widely used. In this paper, the use of virtual technology to design characters needs to pay attention to realism, but also to meet the particularity of film and video animation, and requires a lot of reference to real objects for production. Film and video animation producers need to add expressions and actions to each character, design key frames that match the character's characteristics, and demonstrate through 3D film and video animation simulation to fully demonstrate the consistency of 3D character film and video animation with the real world. This paper analyzes the production process of 3D movie video animation, the bottleneck of 3D movie video animation production and 3D motion capture technology. At the same time, we discuss the modeling of film and video animation creation system.

articleTitle: Big data processing and analysis of transnational trade by fuzzy analysis method and MATLAB
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: With the rapid rise of online sales industry, transnational trade is gradually combined with the Internet. Mastering the development trend of the Internet will be the key to success. Correctly identifying market phenomena and correctly understanding sales products play an important role in product positioning and product development. This paper combines fuzzy analysis and MATLAB modeling to analyze and evaluate cross-border trade products, so as to help consumers and investors make better business choices.

articleTitle: Research on Text Classification of Non-development Work in Software Projects based on Bert
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In order to explore the classification effect of Non-development content text based on Bert pre-training model in software development projects, comparative experiment method can be used for comparative analysis. By collecting a large number of Non-development work content text, the original data set was obtained by manual annotation and classification. The basic model Bert-Base-Chinese, polynomial naive bayes and LSTM model provided by Bert are used to train the corresponding training model on the training set respectively. The Precision, Recall, F1-score and Accuracy of the three models were calculated through the test set. Finally, by comparing the experimental results of the three models, it is concluded that the classification effect of Non-development work in software development projects based on Bert pre-training model is better than that of polynomial naive bayes and deep learning LSTM.

articleTitle: Comparative analysis of electromagnetic characteristics of primary permanent magnet linear motors with different topologies
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The primary permanent magnet linear motor (PPMLM) has good dynamic performance and climbing ability in rail transportation, and also has a very broad prospect due to its own structural advantages. However, different PPMLM topologies have a great impact on motor performance. In this article, three different topological structures of PPMLM are analyzed, and their no-load back potential, no-load flux, thrust and positioning force are compared and analyzed by analytical method and finite element analysis. The results show that the static characteristics of magnetic barrier coupling primary permanent magnet linear motor are obviously better than the other two structures. The research results provide useful reference for further development and application of primary permanent magnet motor.

articleTitle: Finite Element Analysis for Mould of Automobile Suspension Control Arm Based on Ansys
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The mechanical properties of the control arm liquid die forging die was analyzed. First, the thermal principle and method of the control arm liquid forging die were analyzed. The thermal deformation and thermal stress of the control arm liquid forging die are obtained by using ANSYS software to thermodynamic simulation. Finally, the strength and stiffness of the control arm fluid forging die were obtained by ANSYS finite element analysis, so as to design the liquid forging die for automobile suspension control arm that meets the requirements of mechanical properties.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Methods for Fake News Detection
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Nowadays, although it is much more convenient to obtain news with social media and various news platforms, the emergence of all kinds of fake news has become a headache and urgent problem that needs to be solved. Currently, the fake news recognition algorithm for fake news mainly uses GCN, including some other niche algorithms such as GRU, CNN, etc. Although all fake news verification algorithms can reach quite a high accuracy with sufficient datasets, there is still room for improvement for unsupervised learning and semi-supervised. This article finds that the accuracy of the GCN method for fake news detection is basically about 85% through comparison with other neural network models, which is satisfactory, and proposes that the current field lacks a unified training dataset, and that in the future fake news detection models should focus more on semi-supervised learning and unsupervised learning.

articleTitle: Research on Improvement Strategy of Clustering Algorithm Based on Density Parameter Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In the Internet era, the Internet technology is in a rapid development stage, and more and more fields have introduced clustering algorithms. The main function of this algorithm is to process data information. UIn this case, there is no doubt that clustering algorithm has become a hot research topic for experts and researchers. In many clustering algorithms, the most important application is the clustering algorithm based on the density parameter optimization algorithm. This algorithm is simple and efficient in filtering, so it has received widespread attention from researchers. This paper proposes a clustering algorithm improvement strategy based on the density parameter optimization algorithm. Average clustering algorithm, in order to improve the quality of the algorithm, the nearest neighbor collaborative filtering algorithm can be selected. In addition, this paper optimizes the clustering method and clustering characteristics of the clustering algorithm to be better applied to the data analysis process.

articleTitle: Bionic gecko based on intelligent recognition technology
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In nature, every living creature has its unique form, imitating the form, structure and function of biological control theory, can design centralized and efficient mechanical and biological performance. This paper designs a bionic gecko that moves on the wall surface. The bionic gecko adopts the attachment mode of vacuum adsorption, so that it can flexibly complete continuous movement on the wall surface and has good robustness. In view of the difference between the bionic gecko system's motion characteristics on the wall and the ground due to the influence of gravity, this paper carries out quantitative statics and hydrodynamics analysis on the bionic gecko, and the conclusion can provide effective guidance for the mechanical structure design of the bionic gecko. Bionic gecko is mainly used in wall surface defect detection. Machine vision technology combined with deep learning and image processing technology are adopted. With the above computer as the core, the bionic gecko can effectively identify wall surface defects, judge defect types and accurately locate them, and realize wall state feedback. The defect detection module and communication module collect the detection image and video results by CMOS sensor camera and send them back to the host computer. The upper computer module processed and analyzed the image data to obtain the results of cracks and defects. Meanwhile, the collected pavement image data was imported into the database for preservation, and then the feedback detection data was processed and analyzed, so as to generate the corresponding maintenance plan and carry out statistical analysis, which was convenient for professionals to repair later.

articleTitle: The Implied Volatility Surface Analysis Based Trading System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Volatility is a crucial factor in option pricing models. The implied volatility is the estimated volatility from market trades and represents market sentiment in recent research. The implied volatility surface (IVS) based market analysis is also gathering more attention for its satisfying regression performance in risk management and related tasks. In this research, we develop an industrial application of the market trading system based on Support Vector Regression (SVR) and implement simulated trading through backtesting. According to the SPY option historical data experiment results, considering appropriate transaction cost, the system reaches satisfying performance in the fluctuating market.

articleTitle: Robust Control of Robot Manipulator with Uncertain Parameters Based on Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Aiming at the control problem of space robot with load capture, considering the influence of manipulator joint flexibility and the unknown quality of non-cooperative target, a sliding mode variable structure control method based on least square method quality identification is proposed. Firstly, a non-cooperative target quality observer is designed. Then, the dynamic model of flexible joint space robot with floating base is established by using Lagrange method and momentum moment conservation principle. Based on singular perturbation theory, the system model is approximately decomposed into fast and slow subsystems for control respectively. A hyperbolic tangent sliding mode variable structure controller is designed for the slowly varying subsystem to compensate the motion error and ensure the control accuracy; A feedback compensation control algorithm based on velocity difference is designed for the fast changing subsystem to suppress the residual vibration generated by the flexible joint and improve the robustness of the system. Finally, experiments verify the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Research on the Application System of Course Test Questions and Examinations under Computer Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The open online college English computer teaching management system is an open teaching system that integrates classroom teaching and tutoring, courseware production and management. The development and use of the English online examination system has fundamentally changed the traditional examination method and truly separated teaching and examination. The examination system designed by the use of network and computer information technology makes the examination procedures and test propositions of students reach an unprecedented standard, standardizes the examination procedures, and provides a feasible scheme for the reform of English examination methods. The article designs a “Network-based College English Examination System”. The system adopts the C/S and B/S mixed mode of three-tier structure, selects Delphi programming language, and uses SQLServer2000 database as the system development tool. This paper analyzes the composition of the functional modules of the system, studies the technology of test question extraction, and proposes a translation question scoring strategy.

articleTitle: Research on cloud security construction of power grid in smart era
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: With the gradual construction and implementation of cloud computing, the information security problem of the smart grid has surfaced. Therefore, in the construction of the smart grid cloud computing platform, information security needs to be considered in planning, infrastructure, and management at the same time, and it is imminent to build an information network that is secure from terminal to the platform to data. This paper introduces the concept of cloud security technology and the latest development of cloud security technology and discusses the main strategies of cloud security construction in electric power enterprises.

articleTitle: Research on the construction of expressway disease sample set based on the image learning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The automatic recognition of expressway diseases is the core of intelligent maintenance inspection technology, while expressway disease automatic recognition accuracy is affected by the initial disease image sample set. In order to construct a complete and standardized expressway disease image sample set, this paper proposes a method of building expressway diseases sample set based on image learning. By use of image learning, the large amount of collected disease images could be automatically marked, so as to fast build disease sample set, and then provide data support for automatic recognition of expressway diseases.

articleTitle: Optimal Mathematical Modeling of Drug Therapy Based on Gray Correlation Analysis and Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In the last decade, the prevalence and mortality of breast cancer are incremental, which critically intimidates women's health all over the world. Accordingly, to research and analyse the alternative drugs for curing breast cancer is essential. Peculiarly, the quantity of breast cancer patients accompanied by ER. α is giant, and mechanism of the disease is intricate. First of all, this paper carries on the data preprocessing, removes 225 molecular descriptors whose data are all zero, and retains 504 molecular descriptor data as the correlation analysis object of the grey correlation method. Based on the Matlab software, the grey relational analysis model is established. The correlation degree weight of each molecular descriptor is obtained, sorted from large to small, to judge the important extent of the infection of each molecular descriptor on biological activity. Finally, the first 20 molecular descriptors with the most striking effect on biological activity were filtrated. The Spearman correlation analysis of 20 selected molecular descriptors is carried out using Matlab software to test the independence of the index. The color in the distribution map of the Spearman correlation coefficient is basically very light, and most of the results of the p-value test are less than 0.05. It shows significant differences among molecular descriptors, which proves that the selected molecular descriptors have strong independence. It also shows that the grey relational analysis model is very reliable. Definitively, the quantitative prediction model of biological activity on account of neural network and multiple linear regression are set up. The parameters of the quantitative prediction model based around neural network are set as follows: there are fifteen neurons in the hidden layer, and the magnitude of iterations is 1000, and also the disciplinal goal is 0.0000001. On account of the quantitative prediction model set by parameters, the unitary BP neural network structure hidden layer is devoted to inspect the model. Finally, by comparing the predicted values of the two models, it is found that the predicted value distribution of the multiple linear regression quantitative prediction model is stable.

articleTitle: A Study of Big Data Technology for Writing Computer Textbook Looseleaf
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: With the advent of the era of big data in education, course materials resources are accumulating and rapidly increasing in variety, and course knowledge is constantly changing, making it increasingly difficult to analyze and efficiently select knowledge points from a large number of course materials resources; course materials are organized in a variety of forms, resulting in differences in the knowledge structure of course materials, making it more difficult to filter and effectively organize course materials. This makes it even more difficult to select and organize course materials effectively. With the help of data analysis and technical support provided by big data, this paper proposes a method for automatic extraction of course knowledge points and knowledge organization in a big data environment after studying the relevant views and methods on course knowledge points and course knowledge organization at home and abroad, and draws on the successful experience of data mining and text mining in educational data mining to further help teaching resource organizers and teaching resource developers, teachers and others to It further assists teaching resource arrangers and developers, teachers and others to analyze, filter and evaluate course materials, and learners to find and learn relevant knowledge points.

articleTitle: Research on Performance Computer Evaluation Model of Low-Temperature Protective Clothing Based on Explicit Difference Method
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: At present, the research institute has developed a three-layer low-temperature protection composite material. Low-temperature protective materials are mainly used for short-term low-temperature protection, effectively reducing the harm of the external environment to the human body. In this paper, considering that the heat release capacity of the phase change layer is different at different temperatures, according to the data of heat release capacity and temperature of protective materials, the change of heat release capacity Q and field temperature T is fitted by Fourier function, and the functional relationship of material heat release is obtained. Therefore, the model is divided into three stages and calculated separately. In the first stage, there is no self-heating or internal heat source in the three-layer materials, so according to the law of conservation of energy and Fourier law, the unsteady heat conduction formula is deduced and solved. In the second stage, the phase change layer begins to release heat, and the first stage model is added to each layer's heat conduction control equation with heat release capability. The third stage is similar to the first stage. With the help of the explicit difference method, the model is discretized, and the cooling model of materials is solved to effectively evaluate the protective ability of low-temperature protective composites.

articleTitle: Research on Deformation Detection of Traction Wire Rope Based on Non-contact
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The deformation of the traction wire rope includes the deformation caused by traction force and wear. If the deformation of the traction wire rope exceeds the corresponding safety range, it will bring great safety hazards. This paper discusses the non-contact detection method of traction wire rope based on the CCD visual imaging. Different from the method of the traditional contact detection, and it can realize real-time monitoring when the detected traction wire rope is working, and it will not cause damage to the traction wire rope. This paper studies the thinning algorithm of the traction wire rope image about the contour extraction of the traction wire rope image, the straight line fitting of the traction wire rope contour coordinates, and the calculation of the traction wire rope deformation.

articleTitle: Exploration of Paperless Intelligent Accounting Management Based on Financial Middle Platform
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: With the rapid development of economic globalization, the widespread application of computer technology, and the rapid progress of Internet information technology, enterprises of all levels of society are constantly exploring new management concepts and methods in various fields such as production, operation, and management. With the vigorous development of economic informatization, networking, digitization, and intelligence, the informatization of enterprise project management and the digitization of data materials have become an important prerequisite for modern enterprises to achieve better and faster development. This article aims to study the exploration of paperless accounting management based on financial middle platform, based on the analysis of the advantages of accounting paperless, the requirements of financial middle platform mode for accounting file management and the applicability of block chain in electronic invoice management. Designed an electronic accounting file management system, in order to verify the feasibility and effectiveness of the designed system, this article carried out a pilot business to verify. The results showed that after the electronic invoice and paperless accounting went online, the reporting time for a single employee reimbursement process was shortened to 5 minutes, and the reimbursement efficiency increased by more than 50%.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Computer Statistical Technology in Three-Point Shooting Rate Regular Model
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This paper uses three-dimensional video to analyze the three-point shooting movements of several basketball players, and establishes the relationship between the shooting angle, the shooting angle and the height of the parabola formed by the running trajectory of the three-point shooting. Established a database of three-point shooting angle, entry angle, and height of parabola, and developed three-point shooting training software, which has a basis and great help for basketball players' three-point shooting scientific training, which can greatly improve the hit rate.

articleTitle: Image enhancement and noise suppression for Optical Coherence Tomography images based on variational image decomposition and gaussian mixture model
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Optical Coherence Tomography (OCT) images often suffer from low contrast and severe speckle noise. For such need, this work presents a new image enhancement and noise suppression method for OCT images. A new variational image decomposition (VID) model TV-Hilbert-Curvelet is proposed in order to decompose the OCT image into three part: structure, background and noise. And the gaussian mixture model (GMM) is used to generate one binary mask template from the background part, the multi scale Retinex (MSR) is used to enhance the structure part. Experimental results show that the proposed method can enhance the image structure and suppress speckle noise well, and three quality indexes are used to verify the experimental results of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Intelligent Metrological Verification Strategy under the Guidance of Internet of Things Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: It is intended to improve residents' awareness of energy saving and emission reduction, and promote the behavioral energy saving fundamentally, so as to achieve the goal of conducting energy saving. In this work, automation control technology, Internet of Things (IoT) technology, artificial intelligence and big data analysis technology are combined and applied to the improvement and optimization of heating metering. It is attempted to build an intelligent metering management platform under the IoT. The entire heating system is optimized by optimizing the energy-saving plan and implementation approach. As a result, an intelligent metering management system based on the IoT is successfully built. The system can analyze the heating habits of users and other related key information as the heating data of users are monitored and understood in real time. Finally, the targeted regulation can be conducted to achieve the flexible heating.

articleTitle: Research on Flood Disaster Risk Assessment Based on Random Forest Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In flood disaster risk assessment, disaster-pregnant environments, disaster-bearing bodies, and disaster-causing factors are the core categories of risk assessment indicators. A flood disaster risk assessment model based on the random forest algorithm can be constructed by manually identifying the samples and organizing the training data set using the Bagging method. SVM can be selected as a control model for verification to evaluate the model performance further. According to the evaluation of the importance of various influencing factors, it can be found that precipitation, flood duration, and soil moisture content in the local environment are the core factors for evaluating flood disaster risk. In order to cope with the small amount of data for high disaster risk levels, this paper uses the cutoff mechanism in <tex>$\mathbf{R}$</tex> language to correct the random forest results in the voting stage and obtains good results. The research in this paper provides a new idea based on artificial intelligence for flood disaster risk assessment.

articleTitle: Realization of Joint Visualization of Telemetry Data
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In response to the requirements for the visualization of aircraft flight test telemetry data, this paper proposes a visual display method for joint data analysis of aircraft flight test telemetry. This method realizes the organic fusion of telemetry data with the space position and attitude of the aircraft. Simulation experiments show that, with the support of this method, compared with the traditional two-dimensional curve data analysis method, it can significantly improve the information integration degree of the telemetry joint data analysis.

articleTitle: Research on Image Recognition Technology Based on Artificial Intelligence under Computer Big Data
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This paper develops a remote video monitoring system based on ARM; the hardware of the system is based on the ARM S3C2440 embedded chip, and the circuit structure of the main modules such as power supply, Ethernet interface, JTAG interface, and data storage of the hardware system is designed; The software of the system uses Linux as the operating system, uses Video4 Linux to complete video image acquisition, uses JPEG image compression technology to realize video compression processing, and uses real-time transmission protocol RTP to realize video image encapsulation, network transmission, and control. The experimental results show that the method can simultaneously perform real-time online detection of various anomalies such as occlusion, blurring and scene switching that suddenly appear in remote video surveillance, and the accuracy rate can reach 88.75%.

articleTitle: Application Research of Flood Disaster Early WarningSystem Based on Wechat Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The rapid development of mobile Internet technology provides reliable basic conditions for the construction of flood control mobile applications. Aiming at the problem that the current flood control related systems rely on fixed network and office environment and can not meet the query needs of mobile terminals anytime and anywhere, a flood disaster early warning system based on wechat enterprise is designed and implemented, It enables the flood control related personnel certified by the system personnel to obtain safe and reliable real-time water and rain conditions, inundated area risk, disaster early warning, flood avoidance transfer and resettlement and other information in real time, effectively improves the intelligent level of early warning information transmission, and provides technical support for implementing the relocation responsibility in the beach area, popularizing the relocation plan, and guiding the relocation rescue in real time. The system has a certain reference value for the construction of mobile office platform of other related businesses.

articleTitle: Erosion wear of biomimetic valve plug prediction with random forest regression based on Mahalanobis distance: an experimental study
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Erosion wear is not entirely avoidance. Significant erosion occurs due to solid particle impacting, especially in applications involving sand production. The repair of hydraulic equipment in appropriate period can avoid catastrophic disasters. Therefore, the erosion prediction is an essential research for the hydraulic system. After billions of years of evolution, several biology exhibit unique erosion wear resistance performance. The biomimetic design can be a successful approach to overcome the limitations of typical approaches. Thus, we first designed a biomimetic valve plug inspired by biology to improve the erosion wear resistance performance. Then experiments have been conducted under different valve opening, biomimetic valve structure and the results were selected for analysis and prediction. Predicted erosion wear through various machine learning techniques were compared, and the random forest regression (RFR) model was chosen as a practical approach for erosion prediction. Finally, we used Mahalanobis distance (MD) as a structural feature to analyze erosion wear prediction. The results indicate that biomimetic structure with MD structure feature is more accurate. This innovative approach explores the positive role of biomimetic structures in the prediction of erosion wear.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Computer 3D Technology in the Processing and Manufacturing of Clothing
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The article uses 3dsMax and Photoshop to design and 3D reconstruction of clothing. We use 3dsMax to create digital models of clothing using polygonal modeling. At the same time, uv unfold the model and then use Photoshop to draw textures for the built model. Including the drawing of clothing color, pattern and texture. Finally, we realize the establishment of the digital model of clothing. After preparing the computer construction development environment with known parameters, and formulating the reference point and reference line of the clothing design drawing, the experiments were carried out respectively using the traditional virtual design method, the three-dimensional visual design method and the proposed method. The results show that the proposed method produces the smallest size error.

articleTitle: Research on the interactive design of residential facilities landscape based on computer big data
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The urban residents' demand for the city has risen from the initial material basis to the spiritual level. Urban public places have received more and more attention as an important physical space connecting people and people and the city where they live. This paper introduces the concept of interaction design derived from the promotion of big data information technology, and explores the method for interaction design to intervene in the design of urban landscape installations from the five elements of interaction design, in order to provide theoretical reference for the design of future urban landscape installations.

articleTitle: Improving task-oriented dialogue system with double-layer memory decoding
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The model of the task-oriented dialogue system usually consists of an encoder and a decoder, but usually the encoder in the model directly maps the input word vector, and the decoder uses a simple RNN network. Considering that the additional input of dialogue information to the encoded information may affect the performance of the model, we conducted some experiments. In this paper, we propose a new model that redesigns the encoding and decoding process of the task-oriented end-to-end model. Not only additionally adds dialogue raw information in the encoder, but also uses BiGRU as a parsing model for global attention in the decoding stage. Ultimately, our model achieves a breakthrough based on the basic model. We achieve at least 0.2 BLEU score improvement and a minimum 5.9 F1 improvement on the In-Car dataset. And our model also performance well on DSCT2 dataset.

articleTitle: Research on the method of emergency strategy generation for city power grid system destruction
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The power transmission line is always threatened by a huge disaster like a typhoon or earthquake. Human life and economic activities will be greatly damaged while the power system is destroyed by the disaster. In order to evaluate power supply quality and emergency action result in a disaster situation, make a disposal strategy, and predict the result of the strategy, an emergency strategy generation method is proposed. First, the power supply ability is evaluated by the instant grid model. Then, the quality ratio of the power supply is evaluated according to the distribution of users' importance. At last, a strategy generation algorithm aiming at improving the power supply quality is designed.

articleTitle: Quality problems in the process of circuit breaker supervision and corresponding treatment
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Circuit breaker manufacturing supervision is an important part of quality control in the process of circuit breaker manufacturing. This paper expounds the main contents of circuit breaker manufacturing supervision, introduces in detail the quality problems found in the process of circuit breaker manufacturing supervision combined with the production process characteristics of circuit breaker, analyzes the problems in detail, and puts forward corresponding rectification measures to improve the overall quality of circuit breaker, reduce the risk of safe operation of circuit breaker in the future.

articleTitle: Design of side lobe cancellation and anti-jamming of unified carrier measurement and control system based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Direct sequence spread spectrum and spread frequency hopping technologies have certain anti-jamming performance, but their adaptability to complex electromagnetic environments needs further improvement and research. The article proposes a design and analysis of a side lobe cancellation anti-jamming system in a unified carrier measurement and control system. Its core part is designed with FPGA, so that the system has greater potential for expansion and upgrade, and the system is improved in an active anti-jamming way. Ability to work in complex electromagnetic environment.

Author Keywords: unified carrier measurement and control system

articleTitle: Comparative analysis of the impact of multiple faults on the performance of fast repulsion mechanism
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The fast repulsion mechanism plays a crucial role in fast mechanical switching, and although the structure is simple, it is prone to certain failures. To address this issue, this paper first gives a brief overview of the working principle of the fast repulsive mechanism, builds a simulation model of the fast repulsive mechanism using Maxwell, studies three kinds of failures caused by the repulsive disc damage, jamming and unstable capacitor charging voltage, and simulates the above three types of failures and the normal operation state separately for comparative analysis. The results show that when the repulsive disc is damaged, the electromagnetic repulsion force and movement speed will decrease with the increase of the crack depth when the crack depth of the repulsive disc gradually increases; when the jamming force gradually increases, the displacement and movement speed will decrease with the increase of the jamming force; when the capacitor charging voltage gradually decreases, the coil current, electromagnetic repulsion force and displacement will decrease with the decrease of the capacitor, and even cannot the normal division of the gate.

articleTitle: Research on 3D Animation Production System of Industrial Internet of Things under Computer Artificial Intelligence Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Animation production technology has a long history of development. With the continuous reform and innovation of science and technology, traditional animation production technology has opened a new development door. Among them, 3D animation production is an important core of film and television animation, digital media and other majors. The course can also enhance the visual effects of animation production. This paper proposes research on the 3D animation production technology of the Industrial Internet of Things based on computer artificial intelligence technology. In this paper, a multimedia database is introduced to establish a 3D model, combined with the 3D animation theory and the determination of the 3D animation production process, to realize the 3D animation production of the Industrial Internet of Things.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Computer Virtual Reality Technology in the Appreciation of Holographic Projection of Literary Works
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The organic combination of holographic projection digital technology and the analysis of literary works has a positive role in improving the humanistic quality of contemporary students and reforming and innovating education and teaching methods. The deep integration of holographic projection digital technology and literature analysis will have a “revolutionary” impact. This paper proposes an interactive holographic projection method based on Leap Motion. Using Leap Motion's local gesture skeleton recognition technology, it can recognize human gestures to control holographic images, and realize real-time interaction between users and three-dimensional images of literary works. The experimental results show that the method has good real-time performance, strong stability and high user-friendliness.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Internet Technology in Digital Storage System in Traditional Sports
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Under the premise of the continuous development and progress of cloud storage technology, the construction of colleges and universities also needs to be integrated with cloud storage technology to achieve from hardware planning and deployment to software system development, so as to establish an efficient and stable national traditional sports digital teaching resource platform. The article establishes the ADDIE teaching platform (including sports video, 2D/3D animation, sports multimedia courseware and network carrying platform), so that students can learn sports skills, sports rules, injury first aid and other sports knowledge at anytime and anywhere. The system realizes the management of multiple online functions such as course selection, course evaluation, and physical education course resources.

articleTitle: Safety Assessment of Civil Aircraft Lighting System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Lighting system is an important branch of civil aircraft. It not only plays a significant role in the safety and performance of the aircraft and the work efficiency of the flight crew, but also an important component for passengers to evaluate the advancement and comfort of the aircraft. Generally, lighting system is consisted of cockpit lighting system, cabin lighting system, cargo and service area lighting system, exterior lighting system and emergency lighting system. To verify the compliance of lighting system to CCAR 25.1309 during the system developing process, usually adopt the guidelines and methods for system safety assessment put forward by SAE ARP 4761 in civil aircraft conformity certification. The main contents are system functional hazard assessment (SFHA), preliminary system safety assessment (PSSA), common cause analysis (CCA), and system safety assessment (SSA).

articleTitle: Design and implementation of dance teaching live broadcast system of computer network platform
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In artistic aesthetic, dance art is the most beautiful form of expression with special beauty. It can not only convey emotion, but also present beauty. It integrates time and space to express harmonious rhythm. It is not only an art to beautify human action, but also a wonderful appreciation beyond the soul. Dance education presents artistic image based on aesthetic way, which causes influence and inspiration to people under imperceptible influence. In order to improve people's dance appreciation and appreciation level, it is necessary to vigorously popularize dance education for amateurs and non-dance professional students, so as to cultivate their dance aesthetic appreciation, training, performance and other abilities. Dance teaching needs to combine body movements with music, clothing, lighting and other artistic elements, which is limited by time and space, and cannot be carried out on a large scale and on a large scale. The mobile terminal learning mode, based on the video live broadcast and communication mode, directly provides a new development path for dance popularization and education. Therefore, this paper designs the dance teaching live broadcast system with the computer network platform as the carrier.

articleTitle: Visual Performance of DCGAN Model for Analyzing Emoji Generation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: As social media is rapidly developing among the young generations, emojis are becoming increasingly popular in recent years, establishing the need to expand emojis. However, continuously creating new emojis is hard to accomplish due to potential excessive costs and time-consuming. This paper introduces a DCGAN model to tackle this issue, which can generate new emojis by simply learning from the existing emojis input into the model. This application is built up mainly using the Pytorch library in Python. The implementation uses the generator to create plausible emojis to cheat the discriminator by training the model with input real emojis. Then with the results of their operation, these two models are trained repeatedly to improve their abilities. Thus, with this adversarial operation, the generator can produce emojis that have the reasonably authentic quality to pass the test from the discriminator, while the discriminator's accuracy is also continually improving during the training. Eventually, a GUI is created as an image gallery to display the implemented emojis using Tkinter in Python. Overall, this DCGAN model is entirely satisfactory to create new emojis randomly with good quality. However, those emojis generated by this implementation have some quality defects that still need to be refined manually, such as disordered or unclear face features. Therefore, this model can be used as a basic emoji generation program simply for entertainment or commercial use, while emojis inevitably require editing by designers.

articleTitle: Research on fault location model of overhead line and cable hybrid power supply line
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the overhead cable hybrid line spans complex terrain and is easily affected by natural factors such as bad weather and human factors such as piling construction, a double-ended asynchronous fault location equation is established by regarding joint resistance and fault distance as unknown quantities, in this paper. At the same time, the multi-scale quantum harmonic oscillator algorithm is used to solve the fault location, so that the line operation and maintenance personnel can find it in time and take effective measures to restore the power supply to ensure the safe and stable operation of the power system.

articleTitle: Research on DC Reference Voltage Characteristics of Surge Arrester under Low Temperature Conditions in Extremely Cold Regions
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Metal oxide arresters (MOA) are generally installed outdoors, and the temperature will affect the state parameters of MOA. The existing regulations do not provide quantitative reference conversions for the DC reference voltage and leakage current of MOA operating at low temperatures. The value still needs to be judged by experience in the project. Heilongjiang is located in the northernmost part of China, and the temperature in winter is lower than <tex>$0^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$</tex>, or even lower than <tex>$-20^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$</tex>. Therefore, the research on the DC reference voltage characteristics of MOA under low temperature conditions in extremely cold regions can provide guidance for the operation status of arresters at low temperatures, and accurately diagnose the operating status of the arrester.

articleTitle: Effective support of 3D geological modeling technology for fine development of oil field
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Because l oilfield has complex geological conditions, many faults, many oil-bearing series and many types of oil reservoirs, it is jokingly called “a plate is broken and kicked”. Fine development of old oilfields requires improving the description accuracy of geological bodies, so it is necessary to study 3D geological modeling of different types of reservoirs. In recent years, key technologies such as complex fault block structure modeling, ant tracking technology and facies-controlled reservoir attribute modeling have been tackled in L Oilfield, which has achieved continuous innovation and development of oilfield modeling technology. Thereby providing important technical support for oil field productivity construction, geothermal energy utilization and mode conversion, laying the foundation for double improvement of output and benefit.

articleTitle: Application of Computer Big Data and Cloud Computing Technology in the Promotion of E-commerce Advertising
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This article aims to solve the information overload problem faced by large-scale e-commerce systems in the context of big data applications. The scheme of building a distributed e-commerce advertising fixed-point promotion system based on Hadoop is studied. The algorithm based on MapReduce model has high scalability and performance, and can perform offline data analysis efficiently. This paper proposes a decomposition personalized Markov chain (FPMC) model, which combines the MC model with the MF model. The final experimental results verify that the average absolute error (MAE) of the personalized Markov chain (FPMC) model based on content and collaborative filtering is reduced by 15% and 6% compared with traditional content-based or collaborative filtering algorithms. The model can accurately match user information and product information, and match them to complete e-commerce advertising fixed-point push.

articleTitle: Computer Aided Machine Design for Making Pencils from Discarded Chopsticks
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: With the rapid development of the food delivery industry in recent years, the consumption of disposable chopsticks is also increasing at a shocking rate, especially in populous Asian countries. Disposable chopsticks are popular in take-out services due to their low cost and convenience. However, these chopsticks bring severe environmental problems at the same time: they lead to deforestation in natural habitats, ecosystem pollution, and even destruction and near extinction of species; on top of that, the recycling process is not eco-friendly, for the techniques required to recycle disposable chopsticks often involve the heavy use of water resources and environmentally impactful chemicals. While some ways to rework chopsticks do exist (e.g. being made into artworks), there are few efficient methods to regain their value. By constructing an easy-to-replicate machine that can recycle used chopsticks hygienically and, above all, efficiently into pencils, this research project will make a great impact on the chopstick waste problem and also provide cheap pencils without the need to cut down any more trees. Even better, the natural fate of the pencil will allow the waste to be easily used as mulch or compost. To create this automatic machine, technology such as Arduino, 3D printing, Bluetooth, SolidWorks, and AutoCAD are adopted.

articleTitle: Research on Entity Naming Algorithm for NLP Based on Multi-level Fusion Recurrent Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Natural language processing (NLP) entity naming is one of the important contents of NLP. Its function is to extract information with practical meaning from the text so the system can perform high-level analysis. Due to the polysemy of words in traditional language texts, the texts in long, difficult sentences and complex sentences are difficult to be recognized by machines and accurately, which brings certain troubles to the current program naming algorithm. Therefore, it is necessary to design a new NLP entity naming algorithm, through the deep learning algorithm analysis of the language text, fully integrate it so it can be parsed and named by the computer language. This paper first analyzes the problem of entity naming in NLP and introduces the neural network architecture and supporting attention mechanism. It can better recognize natural language named entities.

articleTitle: Research on Network Virtual Printing Sculpture Design under the Integration of Computer Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In view of the shortcomings of low accuracy and large application limitations caused by the use of force feedback device and data glove in the current virtual engraving system for forming trajectory tracking, machine vision was introduced into the field of virtual engraving, and the corresponding experimental system and tracking system were designed. algorithm. The algorithm is based on the least square's method, and improves the connected region detection algorithm in the dynamic search area to achieve high-speed and accurate target positioning. The speed and accuracy of trajectory tracking are verified by programming experiments, and the feasibility of the proposed method is proved.

articleTitle: Application Research of Computer Cloud Computing Technology in the Operation of Natural Gas Long-Distance Pipeline
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This article introduces the development process of the simulation system of natural gas long-distance pipeline. In the design process, VC++ is used to compile the calculation program, and “Kingsview” is used to make the graphical interface and establish the database. This kind of simulation system helps the operator to quickly grasp the changes of the hydraulic process of the whole pipeline when the pipeline is running dynamically.

articleTitle: Research on solar-storage-DC hybrid energy storage based on park distributed grid
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: For the purpose of making full use of the advantages of the hybrid energy storage system and another purpose of trying to make the advantages of each kind of energy storage battery complement each other,and also considering the average weak damping and midiume low inertia of the energy storage converter,one kind of frequency division control strategy of the hybrid energy storage unit based on the virtual DC generator control is proposed.Based on the frequency division control of the hybrid energy storage unit.As a matter of fact, the control strategy adopts the virtual DC generator control for the power density battery energy storage converter to increase the damping and inertia of the power density energy storage and improve the dynamic stability of the DC bus voltage.In order to verify its effectiveness,and also the simulation and comparative analysis of the micro-source variation and load fluctuation and the traditional droop control are carried out,which enhances the charging and discharging part.

articleTitle: CATIA-based cockpit optimization design for Baja racing cars
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The China University Baja Competition requires participating teams to design and build a single-seat, mid-engine, rear-wheel-drive small off-road vehicle, or a four-wheel-drive small off-road vehicle, using the same type of engine, in accordance with the rules of the event and the manufacturing standards of the racing car, at the specified time. During the race, long hours of driving will lead to increased driver fatigue. In order to reduce the driver's fatigue level, this paper, based on the Baja racing cockpit, combines the current international standards and human-computer interaction comfort demand experience, develops the Baja racing cockpit optimization design guidelines, and at the same time, with the help of CATIA simulation software, simulates the optimally designed BSC cockpit model, and finally completes the result analysis to determine The feasibility of the optimization was determined by the final analysis of the results.

articleTitle: An Automatic Pipeline Leak Detection Robot Based on Compound Amphibious Motion
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The safe and efficient operation of oil and gas pipeline is not only related to the development of the enterprise itself, but also related to the safety of energy supply in the development of the country. The innovation and improvement of safety management and operation and maintenance technology is an important guarantee for the safe and efficient operation of the pipeline. However, oil pipeline leakage accidents are still frequent, whether it is man-made damage or natural corrosion will cause more and more losses. Therefore, this paper studies a compound amphibious automatic pipeline leakage detection robot, which can actively run and increase the running speed whether there is oil or no oil. At the same time, it can automatically adjust the posture in the pipeline according to the force feedback to ensure its running speed and stability. In addition, it can use ultrasonic signal detection and analysis to rotate slowly during detection, which improves the detection accuracy, In addition, the telescopic frame is used to increase the coverage range of pipe diameter and improve the applicability.

articleTitle: Research on Optimization Algorithm of Intelligent Connected Vehicle Recognition Based on Long Short-Term Memory Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In recent years, intelligent driving has gradually entered the public's awareness due to the rapid and continuous development of the Internet information age. The most mature application of intelligent driving technology is currently the intelligently networked vehicle, which is capable of applying relevant knowledge in various fields in an extremely comprehensive manner and is being tested for the maturity of autonomous driving technology to a considerable extent. As intelligent networked vehicles have progressed, safety issues in autonomous driving have gradually attracted public attention and become a popular research area. This paper primarily discusses the related issues of intelligent networked vehicles in the context of executing automatic driving and focuses on the identification and optimization algorithms of such vehicles during operation. Additionally, a particle swarm algorithm optimizes the identification optimization process, and a long short-term memory network replaces the relevant characteristics to ensure its operation's reliability.

articleTitle: Research on Diversity Composition Coefficients and Influencing Factors Based on High Bit Rate FM Baseband
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Based on the 4203 high code rate FM band, the actual equipment performance of the composite synthesis technology of the improved signal mass is studied, and the influence factors of the two key analysis diversity synthesis systems are studied, and the relationship between the synthesis agc and the synthesis system is studied.

articleTitle: Research on Comprehensive Evaluation of D&A System Based on BP Neural Network and Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Enterprise information technology is further highly developed, and data becomes one of the strategic assets of enterprises. Scientific evaluation of D&A systems can help data assets to be useful. Therefore, this paper developed a model for evaluating D&A systems to help company executives make the right decisions. We proposed six significant indicators to evaluate the maturity of the D&A system. We built a comprehensive evaluation model combining BP neural network and AHP to evaluate the maturity of the D&A system, and the accuracy rate of the comprehensive evaluation method was 93% after testing. Then we combined the CMM model to get the current maturity of the D&A system at the third “Defined level.”

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Computer Big Data Technology in Statistics of Athletes' Ventilation Time and Stroke Speed Model
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Based on computer big data technology, this paper analyzes the relative peak torque, relative work, and replacement of knee joints of 12 swimming team athletes at three test speeds of 60°/s, 120°/s, and 180°/s in isokinetic flexion and extension. A mechanical study of air time and stroke speed.
