The study found that the relative peak torque and relative work of knee extensors and flexors in swimmers decreased with the increase of contraction speed. At the same time, a swimming propulsion tester is developed in this paper, and the design principle, main technical route and performance of the instrument, as well as the actual test and evaluation mode are theoretically analyzed.

articleTitle: Simulation and analysis of GFDM system performance
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: 5G has the outstanding characteristics of high speed, low latency and large connection and has diversified application scenarios. 5G takes spectrum efficiency, non-orthogonal access, coexistence of multiple services and other factors into account. So, it is necessary to reduce out-of-band radiation as much as possible and reduce interference to adjacent frequency bands. In view of the above requirements, GFDM stands out among 5G candidate waveforms with its flexibility. Therefore, this paper will introduce the modulation and demodulation principle of GFDM and analyze the performance of GFDM system through MATLAB simulation, such as out-of-band radiation, PAPR, self-interference and explain in detail the influence of different parameter settings on GFDM related performance as well as the performance comparison with OFDM in these aspects.

articleTitle: Study on Urban Collision Risk Scenarios Based on AEB-FOT in China
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Based on AEB-FOT(Autonomous Emergency Braking-Field Operational Test), this paper obtains the database in line with the characteristics of urban traffic conditions in China. A collision risk estimation model is established to filter UCRS(Vrban Collision Risk Scenario). Totally 257 UCRS cases are obtained combined with the secondary verification of engineers and expert verification. Based on the collision risk category and the difference of target objects, all cases are divided into six categories, and the basic characteristics of the six categories of scenarios are summarized. UCRS-1 is a conflict scenario with different horizontal overlap, which is called CCRb(Car-to-Car Rearing Braking); UCRS-2 is the conflict scenario between two-wheeled target takes an oblique crossing and VUT(vehicle under test). UCRS-3 is the face-to-face conflict scenario between VUT and target vehicle. UCRS-4 is the conflict scenario between pedestrians and VUT at places without intersection signs. UCRS-5 is a conflict scenario between UVT and target vehicle at the intersection. UCRS-6 is the conflict scenario between cut-in or cut-out vehicles and VUT. Combined with typical scenarios, the UCRS virtual model are established, which proves that there six types of UCRS can be used as virtual simulation scenarios for MIL, SIL and HIL test to promote the development of AD(Automated Driving) functions.

articleTitle: Research on the application of computer graphics aided design in cartoon graphics design of children's hospital
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Children are the group that needs the most attention in the whole society, and the mental health of children is also related to the mental health of all human beings. The cartoon graphics design of children's dental hospital should take children's psychology as a reference to arouse children's interest. Interesting cartoon graphics are applied to the children's dental hospital. The cartoon graphics will make sick children feel happy, which is a relatively subtle aesthetic feeling. Due to the characteristics of children themselves, children will be more interested in interesting things. Based on the analysis of the interest in the design of children's hospitals, this paper further explores the application of computer graphics-aided design in the cartoon graphics design of children's dental hospitals. It is hoped that this will provide some valuable reference for the improvement of the childlike mood in the design of the children's dental hospital.

articleTitle: Construction and Robustness of Directed-weighted Stock Networks with Meso-scale
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: We propose a new algorithm for constructing directed stock networks with meso-scale on the basis of the sliding window method and the Granger causality test. We then construct some directed financial stock networks with meso-scale by using the proposed algorithm on the financial stock data of the Shanghai Stock Exchange divided at the meso-scale level. By simulation, it is found that: (i) In the first half of 2016, stocks are not only more interconnected but also more closely connected. (ii) Under deliberate attacks, the stock market structure was the strongest in the first half of 2016, and the weakest in the second half of 2018; (iii) On the one hand, stock market regulators should face up to the normal stock delisting in the stock market, and on the other hand, they should strictly control the malicious manipulation, protect the important stock nodes, and maintain the stability of the stock market.

articleTitle: Omnidirectional and Variable Density Point Cloud Acquisition Based on Turntable Solid-state LiDAR
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Light detection and ranging (LiDAR) is one of the key devices for 3D environment sensing. Mechanical rotary LiDAR is often used in automatic driving. This is due to its multiple rangefinder sources rotating around their own axes, scanning with fixed resolution and having a small vertical field of view (FOV). The Solid-state LiDAR has no rotating parts and has high stability. It can measure a surface many times in a very short time. However, Solid-state LiDAR has a small horizontal and vertical FOV, which limits its application scenarios. In this paper, Flash LiDAR is combined with a turntable to obtain a larger FOV and variable resolution. Finally, we compare with other similar systems and test it in a real scene.

articleTitle: The application of virtual reality in games
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Virtual reality technology is a rapid development of technology in recent years, for the development of the field of video games has a vital role. Using image display, human-computer interaction, and other technologies to generate a three-dimensional environment. Enable participants to interact and manipulate virtual environments and objects in real-time. This paper analyzes the characteristics of virtual reality technology and expounds application of virtual reality technology in video games. Through the background, the characteristics of VR technology are analyzed. Furthermore, we discuss and analyze the interactive influence of virtual reality on games from the aspects of game sound production and somatosensory interaction. Besides, this article also analyzes the differences between traditional 2D games and virtual reality-based games (Horror games and Escape rooms, for example). Finally, it summarizes the electronic games on virtual reality equipment, shows the positive impact of virtual reality on economy and society, and looks into the future of virtual reality.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Computer Big Data Technology in the Construction of Virtual Simulation Laboratory for Sports Majors
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The application of virtual simulation teaching system in physical education teaching in colleges and universities is an inevitable trend of the integration of information technology and physical education teaching. This paper mainly integrates the characteristics of VR technology and the characteristics of the physical education process itself, and strengthens the application of exercise intensity and load in the VR physical education simulation system. 3D modeling of rehearsal scenes and personnel through virtual reality technology. The entire rehearsal process is simulated with the help of virtual simulation. According to the characteristics of physical education, the system applies virtual reality technology to traditional teaching to achieve autonomous learning and improve teaching quality.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Computer Big Data and Information Visualization Technology in Art Courses
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The article uses computer as an auxiliary teaching method in art teaching, which can not only enrich the content of art teaching, but also provide guidance for students from theory and art creation. The article first analyses the advantages of auxiliary teaching from the application value of computer-aided technology, and then studies the design of auxiliary platform system. The focus is on the analysis of the system's database construction and web search service construction, and the system framework and system teaching process are also given. Finally, the system is applied to the practice of art teaching and has achieved certain results.

articleTitle: UBFH-BOC navigation signal encryption authentication technology based on MMA
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Due to the existing global navigation satellite system (GNSS) is an open, without certification system, satellite receiver is vulnerable to the potential for fraud. Therefore, it is urgent to solve the security certification problem of GNSS civil signals. Aiming at the above problems, this paper proposes a navigation encryption authentication technology based on modulation Method authentication (MMA) based on UBFH-BOC signal system. The results show that the authentication scheme can effectively resist the threat of spoofing, ensure the security of navigation signal transmission, and provide a reference for the subsequent application of high security navigation signal structure.

articleTitle: Research on Gold Bitcoin Synthesis Algorithm Based on Particle Swarm Optimization and Dynamic Programming
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In this paper, we hope to study the transaction process of bitcoin and gold, two unstable assets, to find a trading model that can predict as accurately as possible and put forward a good algorithm. In the beginning, this paper predicted the future price movements of gold and bitcoin based on the long short-term memory neural network model. Then, based on the price of the day, this paper established a strategy model based on the Sharpe ratio and particle swarm algorithm. In order to better quantify the relationship between daily investment risks and returns, we introduced the Sharpe ratio and set the objective function to adjust the position and the value of the Sharpe ratio on the third day when the next three days are unchanged when the objective function is at the maximum value is the situation with the maximum risk and benefit. Finally, this paper established a comprehensive planning model for cash, gold, and Bitcoin through the dynamic programming process. A particle swarm algorithm simulated the optimization process, and the optimal solution was found. We obtained the Sharpe rate on the third day as the objective function.

articleTitle: Stability Analysis of the Red Floor Slope Based on FLAC3D
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Red bed slope has special engineering geological conditions, and its stability is affected by many factors.In order to reduce and prevent the occurrence of various red bed slope accidents, it is necessary to strengthen the research work on the stability analysis of such slope.In this paper, the concrete model of slope is established by FLAC3D software, and the stability analysis of Chongqing road slope is carried out by using rock mass parameters of reduced slope. The differences of slope stability coefficients under four working conditions are analyzed, and the causes of slope instability in Chongqing road are found according to the results.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-target Coverage UAV Network Layout Method Based on Data Analysis Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Multi-objective overlay is a new comprehensive concept that can satisfy multiple constraints and performance metrics while having multiple objective functions independent of the system and is widely used in many fields such as military, aerospace and industry. At the same time, it can meet various requirements for system resources and security in different situations. This paper firstly analyzes the application of data analysis method in UAV network layout method, which mainly performs data screening, data pre-processing, decision tree classification on the collected data, and then plans the UAV network by decision tree classification; secondly, it introduces the multi-objective coverage model of UAV sensors and introduces two commonly used models; finally, this paper studies the data analysis algorithm based on the multi- target coverage UAV network layout method based on data analysis algorithm.

articleTitle: Parameter Optimization Design of PMSM
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In recent years., with the rapid development of permanent magnet materials., the electrical equipment manufacturing industry has also experienced rapid development., and the design and operation methods of electrical equipment are also updated with the development of materials. With its excellent design concept, the PMSM(Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor)can transmit electric energy with high efficiency in a small size, so it is widely used in various industries. Traditional PMSMs have fully met the requirements of most fields in use, but on special occasions, there are high requirements for the ability of the motor to perform work smoothly, such as permanent magnet synchronous servo motors. The synchronous motor's parameter optimization and structural design are carried out to make it work as smoothly as possible, and the output is stable. In this paper, the torque generation and power output of PMSMs are studied, and their parameters are optimized.

articleTitle: Covid-19 Chest Radiography Images Analysis Based on Integration of Image Preprocess and Ensemble Learning Model
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: COVID-19, a highly insidious infectious disease, is now widespread in the world and has caused hundreds of millions of dollars of damage. Rapid detection for COVID-19 is essential for outbreak control, yet existing RT-PCR assays require hours to obtain results and may be incorrect. To enable faster and more accurate detection of COVID-19 infected patients, training neural networks on chest X-ray scans and using the trained models to assist in the diagnosis of lung disease is worth considering. Our team constructed a model consisting of 5 CNN networks of AlexNet, VGG11, GoogleNet, ResNet18 and DenseNet121 with a fully connected neural network using transfer learning and ensemble learning. This model is able to combine the advantages of the 5 CNN networks to get better results. At the same time, we use CLAHE image enhancement algorithm with image augmentation to optimize the training set, which avoids overfitting problem and can further improve the results. With the above approach, we can train a highly accurate ensemble model in a short time to quickly detect COVID-19 infected patients with a small sample of chest X-ray images. Our ensemble model converges quickly and the final test accuracy is 96.48%, which is higher than the test accuracy of any of the five individual CNN networks.

articleTitle: Research on Carbon Sequestration Strategy Based on Entropy Weight Method and TOPSIS Model
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This paper establishes a decision-making model for various forest species, and a forest management plan that maximizes forest carbon sequestration without damaging the environment is given. The model can adapt to a variety of conditions and has good sensitivity. This paper improved the model to consider the impact of managing forests on carbon sequestration, economy, ecological balance, climate, and other factors and gave them weights through the entropy weight method and the TOPSIS method, then re-given a better decision-making plan. This model has better practicability and can be used for different types of forests and can be adjusted according to the needs or preferences of local people, and the solution with the strongest carbon sequestration ability under the conditions that meet the requirements of the conditions can be obtained. This paper applied the above-improved model to two different forests, Geater Khingan Range and Wuyi Mountain. We collected their data for nearly ten years and used the model to make recommendations respectively.

articleTitle: Dual-band antenna with independent band control achieved by two-section stepped impedance resonator
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: in this Letter, a stepped impedance resonator (SIR) dual-band antenna with independent band control using two-section SIR is proposed. The antenna is a double-layer medium substrate structure. The overall dimensions of antenna is 80×40×3.2(mm). The characteristics of SIR antenna are investigated by using transmission-line model method. The two passband frequencies can be designed and tuned independently. To demonstrate the analysis, an antenna with dual-band response operating at 1.57 GHz (GPS application band) and 2.5 GHz (WLAN application band) was designed, fabricated and measured. The measured result shows a good agreement with the analysis and full-wave electromagnetic (EM) simulations results.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Ornamental Fish Recognition Software Based on $\text{iOS}$ and Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The traditional method of artificial identification of ornamental fish species is cumbersome and inefficient, and the accuracy of data cannot be guaranteed. With the development of science and technology, the application of deep learning technology on mobile devices can help us quickly identify ornamental fish species through this method. The machine learning model was built through the VGG16 deep learning network and converted into a Tensorflow Lite model with a high recognition rate. After that, it was deployed to the iOS APP to identify ornamental fish species. At the same time, we have also realized the function of the ornamental fish knowledge base. This software has important practical significance for popularizing the knowledge of ornamental fish.

articleTitle: Research on English Translation System Based on Computer Artificial Intelligence Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Phrase table is a core component of phrase-based statistical machine translation system. The phrase table extracted based on heuristic method is seriously affected by word alignment errors and misaligned words, and the extracted phrases are not syntactical. phrase. The system replaces the original word-based model with a translation model based on phrase template alignment, and proposes a method to calculate the translation probability of phrase templates. In this paper, the IMT method is improved from the aspects of interaction and decoding algorithm. In terms of interaction, the translator is allowed to select the correct translation for the source language phrase from the list of phrase translations before translation. This paper also proposes a diversity sorting algorithm based on phrase table to improve the diversity of phrase candidates. During decoding, words with a reproduction degree of 0 and a high frequency of occurrence are introduced to make the translation result more reasonable. The experimental results show that the phrase-based statistical machine translation method can quickly and effectively build a Chinese-English machine translation platform.
